## Overview

This describes the resources comprising the official REST API. If you have concerns, questions, or requests, please contact [Black Duck Support](https://community.blackduck.com/s/).

### Schema

All API access is over HTTPS, and is accessed from `<https://<hostname>/>`.

Blank fields are omitted from responses.

Timestamps use the `UTC` timezone, and are returned in the format:

```
yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss.SSSZ
```

Throughout this document, a shorthand URL format may be used: `<https://…​/>`. In these cases, this is meant to represent `<https://<hostname>/api/>` where `<hostname>` is the hostname of your Black Duck server.

### Media Types

The API uses custom media types enabling you to choose the format of the data to receive. Requesting a media type also results in a stable, backwards-compatible return. To request a media type, add it as an `Accept` header when you make a request, and as a `Content-Type` header when providing a request body. Responses contain a `Content-Type` header indicating the provided representation’s format.

Media types are documented with individual endpoints, but are grouped by general categories of resources. Currently, Black Duck supports:

```none

application/json
application/octet-stream
```

### Authentication with API Token

Authentication for operations on Black Duck’s REST APIs is done using API tokens. One or more API tokens may be generated for a user within the application

#### Managing API Tokens

Within the user management page in the Black Duck UI, you can generate, re-generate, or revoke individual API tokens. When generating, tokens may be limited to `read` operations, `write` operations, or both. The token value to use is provided upon generating, and inaccessible thereafter. Tokens may be invalidated and re-generated with the same settings from this UI as well.

If an individual token is compromised, it may be individually revoked, preventing unauthorized access.

#### Using API Tokens

After an API token is generated using the Black Duck UI, it can be used by applications to obtain a timed OAuth 2 `Bearer` token for access to API calls. API calls are made as the user associated with the generated token, and expire after a specified amount of time provided in the initial response.

V4

**Request**

```http
POST /api/tokens/authenticate
Accept: application/vnd.blackducksoftware.user-4+json
```

**Request Headers**

| Name            | Description                                                                                                                            |
| --------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `Authorization` | Authentication header of the form `token [API token]` containing an API authentication token to exchange for an authorized bearerToken |

**Response**

```none
{
  "bearerToken" : "[bearer token]",
  "expiresInMilliseconds" : 10000
}
```

*Table 1. Fields*

| Path                    | Type     | Required | Description                                                                                   |
| ----------------------- | -------- | -------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `bearerToken`           | `String` | True     | OAuth bearer token which may be used to access the application within an Authorization header |
| `expiresInMilliseconds` | `Number` | True     | The time in milliseconds before the token will expire and a new one will be required          |

**Header For Subsequent Authorized Requests**

```http
Authorization: Bearer [bearer token]
```

### Authentication with Service Account

Authentication for operations on Black Duck’s REST APIs using Service account credentials. These credentials will be provided through deployment secret.

#### Authenticate

V4

**Request**

```http
POST /api/services/authenticate
Content-Type: application/vnd.blackducksoftware.user-4+json
Accept: application/vnd.blackducksoftware.user-4+json
```

```none
{
  "userName" : "service_genai",
  "password" : "password"
}
```

*Table 2. Fields*

| Path       | Type     | Required | Description                                                          |
| ---------- | -------- | -------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `userName` | `String` | True     | The service account user name, currently only support service\_genai |
| `password` | `String` | True     | The service account password.                                        |

**Response**

```http
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: application/vnd.blackducksoftware.user-4+json
Content-Length: 73

{
  "bearerToken" : "[bearer token]",
  "expiresInMilliseconds" : 10000
}
```

*Table 3. Fields*

| Path                    | Type     | Required | Description                                                                                   |
| ----------------------- | -------- | -------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `bearerToken`           | `String` | True     | OAuth bearer token which may be used to access the application within an Authorization header |
| `expiresInMilliseconds` | `Number` | True     | The time in milliseconds before the token will expire and a new one will be required          |

**Header For Subsequent Authorized Requests**

```http
Authorization: Bearer [bearer token]
```

### Root Endpoint

A `GET` request can be issued to the root API endpoint for links to common starting-point representations within the application. Links will be present/absent based on the features licensed for use, and the permissions of the requesting user.

V4

**Request**

```http
GET /api/
Content-Type: application/vnd.blackducksoftware.status-4+json
Accept: application/vnd.blackducksoftware.status-4+json
```

### Meta Data

Many representations contain a `_meta` element which allows easier access to information such the representation’s URL, the HTTP verbs allowed on that URL (based on requesting user’s permissions), and related links

|  | The links in the response body’s `_meta.links` array are reproduced as a set of `Link` headers in the response headers. However if the response contains too many links, only a subset will be reproduced as headers. In this scenario, you will see a custom header `Warning-Additional-Links` indicating that there are links in the response body which do not appear in the headers. |
| --- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |

```none
{
  "allow" : [ "POST", "GET" ],
  "href" : "https://...",
  "links" : [ {
    "rel" : "rel",
    "href" : "https://..."
  } ]
}
```

*Table 5. Fields*

| Path           | Type     | Required | Description                                                      |
| -------------- | -------- | -------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `href`         | `String` | True     | URL the cotaining representation can be read from or operated on |
| `allow[]`      | `Array`  | False    | The HTTP verbs supported on the URL in the href field            |
| `links[]`      | `Array`  | False    | URLs to resources related to the containing representation       |
| `links[].rel`  | `String` | False    | Key specifying what type of resource is represented by the link  |
| `links[].href` | `String` | False    | URL for the related resource                                     |

### Pagination

Requests that return multiple items will be paginated to 10 items by default. Clients may specify a number of elements to skip, and the maximum elements to read, via query parameters on supporting paths

|  | There is a maximum limit of 1000 items per paged request |
| --- | -------------------------------------------------------- |

#### Pagination Parameters

| Parameter | Required            | Description                                                                                |
| --------- | ------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `offset`  | False (Default: 0)  | The number of results to skip from the beginning of the available set                      |
| `limit`   | False (Default: 10) | The maximum number of results to read from the available set                               |
| `sort`    | False               | A specification of one or more fields to sort results by. Of format `<field> [asc | desc]` |

#### Paged Responses

```none
{
  "totalCount" : 1,
  "items" : [ ],
  "appliedFilters" : [ {
    "name" : "queryKey",
    "label" : "label",
    "selected" : [ ]
  } ],
  "_meta" : {
    "allow" : [ "POST", "GET" ],
    "href" : "https://...",
    "links" : [ {
      "rel" : "rel",
      "href" : "https://..."
    } ]
  }
}
```

*Table 6. Fields*

| Path                        | Type     | Required | Description                                                                                                                        |
| --------------------------- | -------- | -------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `totalCount`                | `Number` | True     | The total number of elements available in the result set                                                                           |
| `items[]`                   | `Array`  | True     | The specific sub-set of items requested                                                                                            |
| `appliedFilters[]`          | `Array`  | False    | Specification of any filters applied to the elements in the result set                                                             |
| `appliedFilters[].name`     | `String` | False    | The key used within a `filter` query parameter to reduce results                                                                   |
| `appliedFilters[].label`    | `String` | False    | The general identifier of the filter                                                                                               |
| `appliedFilters[].selected` | `Array`  | False    | The individual values which may be used when filtering - form is the same as the [filter value responses](#filter-value-responses) |
| `_meta`                     | `Object` | True     | Meta data associated with the representation, as described in [Meta Data](#metadata)                                               |

Page Links

Paged responses contain links to the first, previous, next, and last pages available, when appropriate. These links are optional, and will only be present when a corresponding page is available (for example, if the current response is the first page, there will be no "first" or "previous" links)

Paged links, when provided use "rel" values of:

- `paging-first`

- `paging-previous`

- `paging-next`

- `paging-last`

### Searching

In addition to [Pagination](#pagination), many requests that return multiple items support searching by query parameter. Individual fields that may be searched on vary by endpoint, but follow the form

```
q=<field1>:<value1>,<field2>:<value2>
```

When multiple search keys are specified, search values are AND’d together to determine the resulting behavior.

### Filtering

Requests that return multiple items often support filtering results by specific properties. Unlike [searching](#searching), filters match against exact, defined values, which can be obtained from linked paths. Once obtained, filter values are used in the form

```
filter=<filterKey>:<filterValue>&filter=<filterKey>:<filterValue>&....
```

When multiple filters are specified, filter values with the same keys are OR’d together, and filter values with different keys are AND’d together to determine the resulting filter behavior.

#### Filter Links

The possible filters for a given endpoint are specified by links on the response for that endpoint. The possible link relations for filtering are

| Relation               | Description                                                                                                                                          |
| ---------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `dynamic-filter`       | Link to a filter with values which are determined based on the data available for filtering                                                          |
| `minimum-value-filter` | Link to a filter which accepts input from the form.                                                                                                  |
| `quick-filter`         | Link to a filter which behaves as a boolean toggle                                                                                                   |
| `range-filter`         | Link to a filter with values that are defined by a numerical range                                                                                   |
| `static-date-filter`   | Link to a filter with values that are for dates                                                                                                      |
| `static-filter`        | Link to a filter with values that are not changed based on the data available for filtering                                                          |
| `static-single-filter` | Link to a filter with values that are not changed based on the data available for filtering, and may have only one value specificed in a given query |

The `href` for each link provides the path where the values available for that filter can be read.

#### Filter Value Responses

Each filter value endpoint has a compatible response. Filters are either provided as a flat list, or grouped at the top level.

##### Flat List Response

```none
{
  "name" : "queryKey",
  "label" : "filter label",
  "values" : [ {
    "key" : "queryValue",
    "label" : "value label"
  } ],
  "_meta" : {
    "allow" : [ "POST", "GET" ],
    "href" : "https://...",
    "links" : [ {
      "rel" : "rel",
      "href" : "https://..."
    } ]
  }
}
```

*Table 7. Fields*

| Path             | Type     | Required | Description                                                                          |
| ---------------- | -------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `name`           | `String` | True     | The key to use within a `filter` query parameter to reduce results                   |
| `label`          | `String` | True     | General identifier of the filter                                                     |
| `values`         | `Array`  | True     | The individual values which may be used when filtering                               |
| `values[].key`   | `String` | True     | The value to use with the `name` field in `filter` query parameters                  |
| `values[].label` | `String` | True     | General identifier of the filter value                                               |
| `_meta`          | `Object` | True     | Meta data associated with the representation, as described in [Meta Data](#metadata) |

##### Grouped List Response

```none
{
  "name" : "queryKey",
  "label" : "filter label",
  "values" : [ {
    "label" : "group label",
    "values" : [ {
      "key" : "queryValue",
      "label" : "value label"
    } ]
  } ],
  "_meta" : {
    "allow" : [ "POST", "GET" ],
    "href" : "https://...",
    "links" : [ {
      "rel" : "rel",
      "href" : "https://..."
    } ]
  }
}
```

*Table 8. Fields*

| Path                      | Type     | Required | Description                                                                          |
| ------------------------- | -------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `name`                    | `String` | True     | The key to use within a `filter` query parameter to reduce results                   |
| `label`                   | `String` | True     | General identifier of the filter                                                     |
| `values`                  | `Array`  | True     | The (grouped) values which may be used when filtering                                |
| `values[].label`          | `String` | True     | General identifier of the group of filter values                                     |
| `values[].values`         | `Array`  | True     | The individual values which may be filtered by                                       |
| `values[].values[].key`   | `String` | True     | The value to use with the `name` field in `filter` query parameters                  |
| `values[].values[].label` | `String` | True     | General identifier of the filter value                                               |
| `_meta`                   | `Object` | True     | Meta data associated with the representation, as described in [Meta Data](#metadata) |

### User Summary

Some representations will contain an element that is a summary of a user on the system, for example for use in auditing who created or updated an object. Those representations will be in this format

```none
{
  "userName" : "Username",
  "firstName" : "First Name",
  "lastName" : "Last Name",
  "user" : "/users/2e55e733-b0dc-42b4-a87d-60d7d61581ca"
}
```

*Table 9. Fields*

| Path        | Type     | Required | Description                                                    |
| ----------- | -------- | -------- | -------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `userName`  | `String` | True     | The username associated with the user account                  |
| `firstName` | `String` | True     | The user’s first name                                          |
| `lastName`  | `String` | True     | The user’s last name                                           |
| `user`      | `String` | True     | A link to the full [user representation](#user-representation) |

### Deprecation

APIs are sometimes removed from the product. The first step of this process is to mark such APIs as "deprecated". Reasons for deprecation can include things such as feature removal, legacy format cleanup, or addressing inconsistent pathing/design. Deprecated APIs include two specialized headers:

- A `Deprecation` header with value of `true` to denote deprecation.

- A `BDS-Deprecation` header with simple, short value to denote deprecation reason (e.g. - `feature-removal`) to give context or migration instructions

One or more releases after deprecation, the API will start returning a `410 GONE` response, before being removed completely.

### Legacy/Unsupported APIs

Some APIs, which are not documented within this guide, are not supported for use. These APIs remain due to use by legacy systems and are removed as those systems go offline or migrate to supported APIs. Any APIs which contain `v1` or `internal` in the path, as well as APIs using a media type not documented above, fall into this category. Being unsupported means, among other things, that these APIs are not maintained in a backwards compatible way, may be removed without warning, and when changed are not included in release notes. If you believe you are using such an API, or it is the only way to obtain specific information you need from the product, please contact support to allow us to find an appropriate supported replacement or prioritize providing one.

## Projects

### Project Endpoints

Projects are general classifications of a collection of code that is edited and released under a single label

#### Creating a Project

Creates a new project and project version within the application

V7

**Request**

```http
POST /api/projects
Accept: application/vnd.blackducksoftware.project-detail-7+json
Content-Type: application/vnd.blackducksoftware.project-detail-7+json
```

```none
{
  "name" : "name",
  "description" : "description",
  "projectTier" : 1,
  "projectOwner" : "https://.../users/c96804ba-794e-4343-8a11-b55a671e1f67",
  "projectLevelAdjustments" : true,
  "cloneCategories" : [ "VULN_DATA", "COMPONENT_DATA" ],
  "versionRequest" : {
    "versionName" : "v1.0",
    "nickname" : "nickname",
    "license" : {
      "type" : "DISJUNCTIVE",
      "licenses" : [ ],
      "license" : "https://.../licenses/e920b17f-be6b-4f1c-b3c5-3bc953149f97"
    },
    "releaseComments" : "releaseComments",
    "releasedOn" : "2026-06-17T15:27:49.823Z",
    "phase" : "DEVELOPMENT",
    "distribution" : "SAAS",
    "protectedFromDeletion" : false,
    "update" : false,
    "approvalStatus" : "UNREVIEWED"
  },
  "customSignatureEnabled" : false,
  "deepLicenseDataEnabled" : false,
  "deepLicenseDataSnippetEnabled" : false,
  "projectCloneRequest" : {
    "cloningSettings" : [ "CUSTOM_FIELD_DATA" ],
    "projectVersionsToClone" : [ "https://.../projects/{id}/versions/{id}" ],
    "projectToClone" : "https://.../projects/{id}"
  },
  "projectGroup" : "https://.../project-groups/241f1de5-4b7c-4411-b49b-884c5ff8143d",
  "repository" : "http://test.com",
  "repositoryName" : "repositoryA",
  "repositoryGroupId" : "repoGroupId",
  "unmatchedFileRetentionEnabled" : false,
  "approvalStatus" : "LIMITED_APPROVAL",
  "purgeUnmatchedFilesEnabled" : "NONE"
}
```

```none
{
```

```none
  "projectTier" : 1,
  "projectLevelAdjustments" : true,
  "cloneCategories" : [ "VULN_DATA", "COMPONENT_DATA" ],
  "customSignatureEnabled" : false,
  "deepLicenseDataEnabled" : true,
  "deepLicenseDataSnippetEnabled" : true,
  "snippetAdjustmentApplied" : false,
  "licenseConflictsEnabled" : false,
  "projectGroup" : "https://...",
  "repository" : "https://...",
  "repositoryName" : "repositoryA",
  "repositoryGroupId" : "repoGroupId",
  "unmatchedFileRetentionEnabled" : false,
  "purgeUnmatchedFilesEnabled" : "NONE",
  "approvalStatus" : "DEPRECATED",
  "source" : "CUSTOM"
}
```

*Table 22. Fields*

| Path                            | Type      | Required | Description                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| ------------------------------- | --------- | -------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `name`                          | `String`  | True     | The general identifier of the project                                                                                                                                                                    |
| `description`                   | `String`  | False    | Summary of what the project represents in terms of functionality and use                                                                                                                                 |
| `projectTier`                   | `Number`  | False    | The level of exposure the project has to potential attackers. Possible Values: [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5]                                                                                                        |
| `projectLevelAdjustments`       | `Boolean` | False    | Whether BOM level adjustments are applied at the project level (to all releases)                                                                                                                         |
| `projectOwner`                  | `String`  | False    | URL for the resource representing the project owner                                                                                                                                                      |
| `cloneCategories`               | `Array`   | False    | The set of categories of data to clone when creating a new project version. All possible values are used when this field is absent or set to null. No values are set when this field is set to an empty array. . Possible Values: [COMPONENT\_DATA, VULN\_DATA, LICENSE\_TERM\_FULFILLMENT, CUSTOM\_FIELD\_DATA, VERSION\_SETTINGS, DEEP\_LICENSE] |
| `customSignatureEnabled`        | `Boolean` | False    | If the project should be matched against for future scans                                                                                                                                                |
| `deepLicenseDataEnabled`        | `Boolean` | False    | Whether Deep License Data is computed, only valid when Deep License Data is enabled                                                                                                                      |
| `deepLicenseDataSnippetEnabled` | `Boolean` | False    | Whether Deep License Data on Snippet Matches is enabled, only valid when Deep License Data is enabled                                                                                                    |
| `snippetAdjustmentApplied`      | `Boolean` | False    | Whether snippet adjustment for partial snippet match is applied to full file snippet match                                                                                                               |
| `licenseConflictsEnabled`       | `Boolean` | False    | Whether license conflicts are computed                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `projectGroup`                  | `String`  | False    | The URL of the project group to which the project must be assigned. If a project group is not specified, the project will be assigned to the root level project group.                                   |
| `repository`                    | `String`  | False    | The URL to this project SCM repository                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `repositoryName`                | `String`  | False    | The name of this project SCM repository                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `repositoryGroupId`             | `String`  | False    | The Repository GroupId of this project SCM repository                                                                                                                                                    |
| `unmatchedFileRetentionEnabled` | `Boolean` | False    | Whether unmatched files are retained for all releases of the project. If unspecified, the global setting is used.                                                                                        |
| `purgeUnmatchedFilesEnabled`    | `String`  | False    | Whether existing unmatched files are purged for all releases of the project. Possible values are "NONE", "ARCHIVED", and "ALL". If unspecified, the global setting is used.                              |
| `url`                           | `String`  | False    | The project homepage URL                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `approvalStatus`                | `String`  | False    | The level of approval that has been given to use this project. Possible Values: [UNREVIEWED, IN\_REVIEW, REVIEWED, APPROVED, LIMITED\_APPROVAL, REJECTED, DEPRECATED]                                    |

**Response**

The updated [project representation](#project-representation)

| `repositoryName`                | `String`  | False    | The name of this project SCM repository                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `repositoryGroupId`             | `String`  | False    | The Repository GroupId of this project SCM repository                                                                                                                                                    |
| `unmatchedFileRetentionEnabled` | `Boolean` | False    | Whether unmatched files are retained for all releases of the project. If unspecified, the global setting is used.                                                                                        |
| `purgeUnmatchedFilesEnabled`    | `Varies`  | False    | Whether existing unmatched files are purged for all releases of the project. If unspecified, the global setting is used.                                                                                 |
| `url`                           | `String`  | False    | The project homepage URL                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `deepLicenseDataEnabled`        | `Boolean` | False    | Whether Deep License Data is computed, only valid when Deep License Data is enabled                                                                                                                      |
| `deepLicenseDataSnippetEnabled` | `Boolean` | False    | Whether Deep License Data on Snippet Matches is enabled, only valid when Deep License Data is enabled                                                                                                    |
| `licenseConflictsEnabled`       | `Boolean` | False    | Whether license conflicts are computed                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `approvalStatus`                | `String`  | False    | The level of approval that has been given to use this project. Possible Values: [UNREVIEWED, IN\_REVIEW, REVIEWED, APPROVED, LIMITED\_APPROVAL, REJECTED, DEPRECATED]                                    |
| `_meta`                         | `Object`  | True     | Meta data associated with the representation, as described in [Meta Data](#metadata)                                                                                                                     |

*Table 51. Links*

| Relation                    | Description                                                                                                                                     |
| --------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `versions`                  | Resource listing versions associated with project                                                                                               |
| `canonicalVersion`          | Resource representing the canonical version of the project, if specified                                                                        |
| `assignable-users`          | Resource representing users assignable to the project                                                                                           |
| `assignable-usergroups`     | Resource representing user groups assignable to the project                                                                                     |
| `users`                     | Resource representing users assigned to the project                                                                                             |
| `usergroups`                | Resource representing user groups assigned to the project                                                                                       |
| `roles`                     | Resource representing roles assigned to the project                                                                                             |
| `tags`                      | Resource representing project tags                                                                                                              |
| `project-mappings`          | Resource representing application identifier(s) mapped to the project                                                                           |
| `project-journal`           | Resource representing the journal for the project                                                                                               |
| `custom-fields`             | Resource representing the project’s custom fields                                                                                               |
| `sbom-fields`               | Resource representing the project’s sbom fields                                                                                                 |
| `lts-project-versions`      | Resource listing the project’s LTS versions                                                                                                     |
| `notification-subscription` | Resource representing a subscription to notifications related to the project. Not present if the current user is not subscribed to this project |
| `scm`                       | Resource representing scm related data of this project                                                                                          |

### Project Version Search

application/vnd.blackducksoftware.report-1+csv

**Request**

```http
GET /api/search/project-versions
Accept: application/vnd.blackducksoftware.report-1+csv
```

*Table 69. Parameters*

| Parameter | Required            | Description                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| --------- | ------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `offset`  | False (Default: 0)  | The number of results to skip from the beginning of the available set                                                                                                                                    |
| `limit`   | False (Default: 10) | The maximum number of results to read from the available set                                                                                                                                             |
| `sort`    | False               | A specification of one or more fields to sort results by. Of format `<field> [asc | desc]`. Sortable Fields: [componentcount, lastscanmodified, parentprojectgroupname, policyprofile, projectlastupdatedat, projectname, riskprofile.categories.license, riskprofile.categories.operational, riskprofile.categories.vulnerability, versionname] |
| `q`       | False               | Search Param to search for project versions                                                                                                                                                              |

#### Reading a Single Project Custom Field

V5

```http
GET /api/projects/{projectId}/custom-fields/{customFieldId}
Accept: application/vnd.blackducksoftware.project-detail-5+json
```

**Response**

The corresponding [project custom field representation](#project-custom-field-representation)

#### Updating a Project Custom Field

This endpoint updates the saved value in a custom field for a given project. The acceptable format of the values field varies depending on the data type of the custom field:

- For BOOLEAN custom fields this should be an array of a single string, 'true' or 'false'.

- For DATE custom fields this should be an array of a single string, in the date format yyyy-MM-dd’T’HH:mm:ss.SSS’Z' (i.e. 2019-04-25T09:57:21.051Z)

- For MULTISELECT custom fields this should be an array of hrefs to the options which have been selected.

- For all other types of fields with options this should be an array of a single href to the selected option.

- For all other types of fields without options this should be an array of a single plain string to store.

V5

**Request**

```http
PUT /api/projects/{projectId}/custom-fields/{customFieldId}
Accept: application/vnd.blackducksoftware.project-detail-5+json
Content-Type: application/vnd.blackducksoftware.project-detail-5+json
```

```none
{
  "values" : [ "New Value" ]
}
```

*Table 87. Fields*

| Path     | Type    | Required | Description                                                     |
| -------- | ------- | -------- | --------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `values` | `Array` | True     | The new data to store in the custom field for the given project |

**Response**

The updated [project custom field representation](#project-custom-field-representation)

#### Project Custom Field Representation

Project custom field representations from the list, single read, and other responses follow a consistent form:

V5

```none
{
  "position" : 0,
  "label" : "Custom Field",
  "description" : "This is a description.",
  "type" : "TEXT",
  "active" : true,
  "values" : [ "value" ],
  "required" : false,
  "_meta" : {
    "allow" : [ "GET", "PUT" ],
    "href" : "https://...",
    "links" : [ ]
  }
}
```

*Table 88. Fields*

| Path          | Type      | Required | Description                                                                                                      |
| ------------- | --------- | -------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `position`    | `Number`  | True     | The location of the object within the project’s list of custom fields                                            |
| `label`       | `String`  | True     | The name of the custom field                                                                                     |
| `description` | `String`  | False    | A more detailed description of the custom field                                                                  |
| `type`        | `String`  | True     | The datatype of the custom field. Possible Values: [TEXT, TEXTAREA, DROPDOWN, RADIO, MULTISELECT, BOOLEAN, DATE] |
| `active`      | `Boolean` | True     | Whether the custom field is active or not. Inactive custom fields are not displayed in the UI                    |
| `values`      | `Array`   | False    | The data stored in the custom field for this specific project. Will be null if there is no data stored           |
| `required`    | `Boolean` | True     | Whether the custom field is required or not                                                                      |
| `_meta`       | `Object`  | True     | Meta data associated with the representation, as described in [Meta Data](#metadata)                             |

*Table 89. Links*

| Relation                   | Description                                                                                                                     |
| -------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `custom-field-option-list` | Resource listing options associated with this custom field. Present only for custom fields whose type supports creating options |

*Table 125. Filters*

| Filter      | Description                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| ----------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `exactName` | The exact name filter only has an effect when the name search parameter is specified. If the exact name filter is true, then only the project group that case-insensitive matches the name provided (if it exists) will be returned. |
| `writable`  | The writable filter changes the project groups returned based on the logged in user's permissions. If the filter is not set or is set to false, any project group the user can read will be returned. If the filter is set to true, the search will only return project groups that the user can edit. |

#### Project Group Representation

Project group representations from the single read, and other responses follow a consistent form:

V5

```none
{
  "name" : "name",
  "description" : "description",
  "createdAt" : "2026-06-17T15:27:42.579Z",
  "updatedAt" : "2026-06-17T15:27:42.579Z",
  "depth" : 1,
  "directChildProjectCount" : 2,
  "directChildProjectGroupCount" : 3,
  "_meta" : {
    "allow" : [ "DELETE", "GET", "PUT" ],
    "href" : "https://...",
    "links" : [ {
      "rel" : "root-project-group",
      "href" : "https://..."
    }, {
      "rel" : "parent-project-group",
      "href" : "https://..."
    }, {
      "rel" : "children",
      "href" : "https://..."
    }, {
      "rel" : "descendants",
      "href" : "https://..."
    }, {
      "rel" : "possible-child-project-groups",
      "href" : "https://..."
    }, {
      "rel" : "assigned-usergroups",
      "href" : "https://..."
    }, {
      "rel" : "assigned-users",
      "href" : "https://..."
    }, {
      "rel" : "destination-project-groups",
      "href" : "https://..."
    }, {
      "rel" : "project-group-sbom-fields",
      "href" : "https://..."
    } ]
  }
}
```

*Table 132. Fields*

| Path                           | Type     | Required | Description                                                                          |
| ------------------------------ | -------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `name`                         | `String` | True     | The name of the project group                                                        |
| `description`                  | `String` | True     | The description of the project group                                                 |
| `createdAt`                    | `String` | True     | Date when the child was created                                                      |
| `updatedAt`                    | `String` | True     | Date when the child was last updated                                                 |
| `depth`                        | `Number` | True     | The number of ancestors the project group has including the root project             |
| `directChildProjectCount`      | `Number` | True     | Number of direct child projects                                                      |
| `directChildProjectGroupCount` | `Number` | True     | Number of direct child project groups                                                |
| `_meta`                        | `Object` | True     | Meta data associated with the representation, as described in [Meta Data](#metadata) |

*Table 133. Links*

| Relation                        | Description                                                                    |
| ------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `root-project-group`            | Resource representing root project group                                       |
| `parent-project-group`          | Resource representing parent project group of this project group               |
| `children`                      | Resource representing chidren of this project group                            |
| `descendants`                   | Resource representing descendants of this project group                        |
| `possible-child-project-groups` | Resource representing possible children (project groups) of this project group |
| `assigned-usergroups`           | Resource representing user groups assigned to this project group               |
| `assigned-users`                | Resource representing users assigned to this project group                     |
| `destination-project-groups`    | Resource representing destinations of this project group                       |
| `project-group-sbom-fields`     | Resource representing SBOM fields of this project group                        |

### Project Group Assignment Endpoints

These endpoints relate to assigning users and user groups to project groups.

This endpoint will respond with 201 Created if the user was successfully added, or 204 No Content if the user was already assigned to the project group

## Bill of Materials

The Bill of Materials (BOM) is the collection of components used within a Project Version

### BOM Status Endpoints

#### Reading a BOM’s Status

The summary describes the overall status of all the events for a given BOM.

- `UP_TO_DATE`: No events

- `UP_TO_DATE_WITH_ERRORS`: No messages are being processed, one or more events have failed

- `PROCESSING`: One or more events are in progress

- `PROCESSING_WITH_ERRORS`: One or more events are in progress, one or more events have failed

V6

**Request**

```http
GET /api/projects/{projectId}/versions/{projectVersionId}/bom-status
Accept: application/vnd.blackducksoftware.bill-of-materials-6+json
```

**Response**

```http
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Link: </projects/af4b96eb-885e-46d1-85c1-27711cfe42bc/versions/4c1621f6-79fc-43c8-b399-7cdd31faa440/bom-status>;rel="self"

}
```

| `status`            | `String` | True     | The overall status of the BOM. Possible Values: [UP\_TO\_DATE, UP\_TO\_DATE\_WITH\_ERRORS, PROCESSING, PROCESSING\_WITH\_ERRORS] |
| `lastScanDate`      | `String` | False    | The last date/time a scan contributed to the BOM                                                                                 |
| `lastBomUpdateDate` | `String` | False    | The last date/time a BOM is updated                                                                                              |
| `_meta`             | `Object` | True     | Meta data associated with the representation, as described in [Meta Data](#metadata)                                             |

#### Reading a BOM’s Status for a scan

The status describes if bill of material includes the scan.

- `NOT_INCLUDED`: BOM doesn’t contain matches from the scan

- `BUILDING`: BOM is being prepared for the scan

- `SUCCESS`: BOM is ready and contains matches from the scan

- `FAILURE`: Failed to prepare BOM for the scan

V6

**Request**

```http
GET /api/projects/{projectId}/versions/{projectVersionId}/bom-status/{scanId}
Accept: application/vnd.blackducksoftware.bill-of-materials-6+json
```

**Response**

```http
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Link: </projects/028f6ea0-525f-47f5-938b-982e69163f2f/versions/b36e1683-fa98-4ee9-9ca6-e582ee6c681f/bom-status/a2568f19-ad0b-4582-a89b-cea234179a34>;rel="self"
Allow: GET
Content-Type: application/vnd.blackducksoftware.bill-of-materials-6+json
Content-Length: 116

{
  "status" : "SUCCESS",
  "_meta" : {
    "allow" : [ "GET" ],
    "href" : "https://...",
    "links" : [ ]
  }
}
```

| -------- | -------- | -------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |

| `_meta`  | `Object` | True     | Meta data associated with the representation, as described in [Meta Data](#metadata)           |

#### Deleting a Failed BOM Event

Deletes an existing failed BOM Event from the system. If the BOM Event with the given ID has not failed, calling this endpoint will result in a Bad Request.

V6

**Request**

```http
DELETE /api/projects/{projectId}/versions/{projectVersionId}/bom-events/{bomEventId}
Accept: application/vnd.blackducksoftware.bill-of-materials-6+json
```

**Response**

```http
HTTP/1.1 204 No Content
```

#### Deleting all Failed Events From a BOM

Deletes all BOM Events for a given BOM that are in the failed state. If there are no events in the failed state, this endpoint is a no-op.

V6

**Request**

```http
DELETE /api/projects/{projectId}/versions/{projectVersionId}/bom-events
Accept: application/vnd.blackducksoftware.bill-of-materials-6+json
```

**Response**

```http
HTTP/1.1 204 No Content
```

#### Updating BOM Vulnerability Remediations

Applies the remediation to the components and vulnerabilities found based on the provided data.
A vulnerability and its associated related vulnerability are tightly coupled, the related vulnerability should always be provided if exists.
If component is left out, the remediation is applied to all component origins with the provided vulnerability pair.
If component version is specified, the remediation is applied to all component origins with the provided vulnerability pair and component version.

V8

**Request**

```http
PUT /api/projects/{projectId}/versions/{projectVersionId}/vulnerabilities
Content-Type: application/vnd.blackducksoftware.bill-of-materials-8+json
Accept: application/vnd.blackducksoftware.bill-of-materials-8+json
```

```none
{
  "remediationStatus" : "NOT_AFFECTED",
  "remediationJustification" : "MITIGATION",
```

#### Reading a BOM Component Version’s Vulnerability Remediation

Reads the vulnerability remediation for a single BOM component version. For BOM component versions that have an origin ID, use the [Reading a BOM Component Version Origins’s Vulnerability Remediation](#read-bom-component-version-origin-vulnerability) endpoint.

V6

**Request**

```http
GET /api/projects/{projectId}/versions/{projectVersionId}/components/{componentId}/versions/{componentVersionId}/vulnerabilities/{vulnerabilityId}/remediation
Accept: application/vnd.blackducksoftware.bill-of-materials-6+json
```

**Response**

The corresponding [BOM component vulnerability remediation representation](#bom-component-vulnerability-remediation-representation)

#### Reading a BOM Component Version Origin’s Vulnerability Remediation

Reads the vulnerability for a single BOM component version with an origin ID set. For BOM component versions that don’t have an origin ID, use the [Reading a BOM Component Version’s Vulnerability Remediation](#read-bom-component-version-vulnerability) endpoint.

V6

**Request**

```http
GET /api/projects/{projectId}/versions/{projectVersionId}/components/{componentId}/versions/{componentVersionId}/origins/{originId}/vulnerabilities/{vulnerabilityId}/remediation
Accept: application/vnd.blackducksoftware.bill-of-materials-6+json
```

**Response**

The corresponding [BOM component vulnerability remediation representation](#bom-component-vulnerability-remediation-representation)

#### Updating a BOM Component Version’s Vulnerability Remediation

Updates the vulnerability remediation for a single BOM component version. For BOM component versions that have an origin ID, use the [Updating a BOM Component Version Origin’s Vulnerability Remediation](#update-bom-component-version-origin-vulnerability-remediation) endpoint

V6

**Request**

```http
PUT /api/projects/{projectId}/versions/{projectVersionId}/components/{componentId}/versions/{componentVersionId}/vulnerabilities/{vulnerabilityId}/remediation
Content-Type: application/vnd.blackducksoftware.bill-of-materials-6+json
```

```none
{
  "remediationJustification" : "NO_CODE",
  "comment" : "updated comment",
  "remediationStatus" : "NOT_AFFECTED"
}
```

*Table 165. Fields*

| Path                       | Type     | Required | Description                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| -------------------------- | -------- | -------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `comment`                  | `String` | False    | Pertinent comments associated with the vulnerability remediation                                                                                                                                         |
| `remediationStatus`        | `String` | True     | The remediation status of the BOM component. Possible Values: [REMEDIATION\_COMPLETE, NOT\_AFFECTED, MITIGATED, DUPLICATE, IGNORED, PATCHED, NEW, UNDER\_INVESTIGATION, NEEDS\_REVIEW, AFFECTED, REMEDIATION\_REQUIRED] |
| `remediationJustification` | `String` | False    | The remediation justification of the BOM component. Possible Values: [NO\_COMPONENT, NO\_CODE, NOT\_CONTROLLED, NOT\_EXECUTED, ALREADY\_MITIGATED, MITIGATION, NO\_FIX\_PLANNED, NONE\_AVAILABLE, VENDOR\_FIX, WORKAROUND] |

**Response**

```http
HTTP/1.1 202 Accepted
```

#### Updating a BOM Component Version Origin’s Vulnerability Remediation

Updates the vulnerability remediation for a single BOM component version origin. For BOM component versions that don’t have an origin ID, use the [Updating a BOM Component Version’s Vulnerability Remediation](#update-bom-component-version-vulnerability-remediation) endpoint

V6

**Request**

```http
PUT /api/projects/{projectId}/versions/{projectVersionId}/components/{componentId}/versions/{componentVersionId}/origins/{originId}/vulnerabilities/{vulnerabilityId}/remediation
Content-Type: application/vnd.blackducksoftware.bill-of-materials-6+json
```

```none
{
  "remediationJustification" : "NO_CODE",
  "comment" : "updated comment",
  "remediationStatus" : "NOT_AFFECTED"
}
```

*Table 166. Fields*

| Path                       | Type     | Required | Description                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| -------------------------- | -------- | -------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `comment`                  | `String` | False    | Pertinent comments associated with the vulnerability remediation                                                                                                                                         |
| `remediationStatus`        | `String` | True     | The remediation status of the BOM component. Possible Values: [REMEDIATION\_COMPLETE, NOT\_AFFECTED, MITIGATED, DUPLICATE, IGNORED, PATCHED, NEW, UNDER\_INVESTIGATION, NEEDS\_REVIEW, AFFECTED, REMEDIATION\_REQUIRED] |
| `remediationJustification` | `String` | False    | The remediation justification of the BOM component. Possible Values: [NO\_COMPONENT, NO\_CODE, NOT\_CONTROLLED, NOT\_EXECUTED, ALREADY\_MITIGATED, MITIGATION, NO\_FIX\_PLANNED, NONE\_AVAILABLE, VENDOR\_FIX, WORKAROUND] |

### BOM Component Endpoints

#### Adding a Component to the BOM

V6

**Request**

```http
POST /api/projects/{projectId}/versions/{projectVersionId}/components
Content-Type: application/vnd.blackducksoftware.bill-of-materials-6+json
```

```none
{
  "component" : "https://.../components/{componentId}",
  "componentPurpose" : "purpose",
  "componentModified" : true,
  "componentModification" : "modification",
  "license" : "https://.../licenses/{licenseId}"
}
```

*Table 168. Fields*

| Path                    | Type      | Required | Description                                                                                                               |
| ----------------------- | --------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `component`             | `String`  | True     | URL to the representation of the component, component version, project, or project version to add to the BOM              |
| `componentModification` | `String`  | False    | Description of component modification                                                                                     |
| `componentModified`     | `Boolean` | False    | Displays whether the component has been modified                                                                          |
| `componentPurpose`      | `String`  | False    | The purpose of the component                                                                                              |
| `license`               | `String`  | False    | The adjusted license of the component. If not provided, the component or project version’s original license will be used. |

**Response**

```http
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
```

#### Reading a Single BOM Component

This response only exists for BOM entries with no known version - use `api/projects/{projectId}/versions/{projectVersionId}/components/{componentId}/versions/{componentVersionId}` instead for entries with a version. Both endpoints should generally be accessed via a link returned as part of the BOM component list endpoint.

The updated [BOM component representation](#bom-component-representation)

#### Bulk Component Adjustments

Apply an adjustment to multiple components.

V7

**Request**

```http
PATCH /api/projects/{projectId}/versions/{projectVersionId}/bulk-adjustment
Accept: application/vnd.blackducksoftware.bill-of-materials-7+json
Content-Type: application/vnd.blackducksoftware.bill-of-materials-7+json
```

```none
{
  "components" : [ "/api/projects/{projectId}/versions}/{projectVersionId}/components/{componentId}", "/api/projects/{projectId}/versions}/{projectVersionId}/components/{componentId}/versions/{componentVersionId}" ],
  "reviewStatus" : "REVIEWED",
  "ignored" : true,
  "usage" : "DYNAMICALLY_LINKED",
  "inAttributionReport" : true,
  "confirmed" : true
}
```

| `usage`               | `String`  | False    | The usage to set for the components                          |

#### Restoring a BOM Component’s License Text

Sending a DELETE request to this endpoint will remove any custom text and restore this component’s license to its original state.

**Request**

```http
DELETE /api/projects/{projectId}/versions/{projectVersionId}/components/{componentId}/licenses/{licenseId}/text
```

**Response**

```http
HTTP/1.1 204 No Content
```

#### Restoring a BOM Component Version’s License Text

Sending a DELETE request to this endpoint will remove any custom text and restore this component version’s license to its original state.

**Request**

```http
DELETE /api/projects/{projectId}/versions/{projectVersionId}/components/{componentId}/versions/{componentVersionId}/licenses/{licenseId}/text
```

**Response**

```http
HTTP/1.1 204 No Content
```

#### Updating BOM Component Custom Fields

This endpoint updates the saved values for custom fields for a BOM Component. The acceptable format of the values fields vary depending on the data type of the custom field:

- For BOOLEAN custom fields this should be an array of a single string, 'true' or 'false'.

- For DATE custom fields this should be an array of a single string, in the date format yyyy-MM-dd’T’HH:mm:ss.SSS’Z' (i.e. 2019-04-25T09:57:21.051Z)

- For MULTISELECT custom fields this should be an array of hrefs to the options which have been selected.

- For all other types of fields with options this should be an array of a single href to the selected option.

- For all other types of fields without options this should be an array of a single plain string to store.

V7

**Request**

```http
PUT /api/projects/{projectId}/versions/{projectVersionId}/components/{componentId}/custom-fields
Accept: application/vnd.blackducksoftware.bill-of-materials-7+json
Content-Type: application/vnd.blackducksoftware.bill-of-materials-7+json
```

```none
{
  "fields" : [ {
    "customField" : "Custom Field",
    "values" : [ "value" ]
  } ]
}
```

*Table 243. Fields*

| Path                   | Type     | Required | Description                                   |
| ---------------------- | -------- | -------- | --------------------------------------------- |
| `fields`               | `Array`  | True     | Updates for BOM component custom fields       |
| `fields[].customField` | `String` | True     | BOM component custom field URL                |
| `fields[].values`      | `Array`  | True     | New values for the BOM component custom field |

**Response**

```none
{
  "totalCount" : 1,
  "items" : [ {
    "position" : 0,
    "label" : "Custom Field",
    "description" : "This is a description.",
    "type" : "TEXT",
    "active" : true,
    "values" : [ "value" ],
    "required" : false,
    "_meta" : {
      "allow" : [ "GET", "PUT" ],
      "href" : "https://...",
      "links" : [ ]
    }
  } ],
  "appliedFilters" : [ ],
  "_meta" : {
    "allow" : [ "GET", "PUT" ],
    "href" : "https://...",
    "links" : [ ]
  }
}
```

*Table 244. Fields*

| Path                  | Type      | Required | Description                                                                                                              |
| --------------------- | --------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `totalCount`          | `Number`  | True     | The number of custom fields updated                                                                                      |
| `items[]`             | `Array`   | True     | The updated custom fields                                                                                                |
| `items[].position`    | `Number`  | True     | The location of the object within the BOM entry’s list of custom fields                                                  |
| `items[].label`       | `String`  | True     | The name of the updated custom field                                                                                     |
| `items[].description` | `String`  | False    | A more detailed description of the updated custom field                                                                  |

| `_meta`               | `Object`  | True     | Meta data associated with the representation, as described in [Meta Data](#metadata)                                     |

### BOM Policy Endpoints

#### Reading the Policy Status of a BOM

This is the overall policy status of a BOM. If no components are violating a policy it will read: NOT_IN_VIOLATION. However, if one or more
components are violating a policy, the BOM status will read: IN_VIOLATION.

V6

**Request**

```http
GET /api/projects/{projectId}/versions/{projectVersionId}/policy-status
Accept: application/vnd.blackducksoftware.bill-of-materials-6+json
```

**Response**

```none
{
  "overallStatus" : "IN_VIOLATION",
  "updatedAt" : "2026-06-17T15:26:55.228Z",
  "componentVersionStatusCounts" : [ {
    "name" : "NOT_IN_VIOLATION",
    "value" : 0
  }, {
    "name" : "IN_VIOLATION_OVERRIDDEN",
    "value" : 1
  }, {
    "name" : "IN_VIOLATION",
    "value" : 2
  } ],
  "componentVersionPolicyViolationDetails" : {
    "name" : "IN_VIOLATION",
    "severityLevels" : [ {
      "name" : "BLOCKER",
      "value" : 1
    }, {
      "name" : "CRITICAL",
      "value" : 1
    }, {
      "name" : "MAJOR",
      "value" : 0
    }, {
      "name" : "MINOR",
      "value" : 0
    }, {
      "name" : "TRIVIAL",
      "value" : 0
    }, {
      "name" : "UNSPECIFIED",
      "value" : 0
    } ]
  },
  "_meta" : {
    "allow" : [ "GET" ],
    "href" : "https://...",
    "links" : [ ]
  }
}
```

| `updatedAt`                                                     | `String` | False    | The date/time the policy status was last updated.                                                                                                                  |
| `componentVersionStatusCounts`                                  | `Array`  | False    | The number of components holding each status.                                                                                                                      |
| `componentVersionStatusCounts[].name`                           | `String` | False    | The violation status. Possible Values: [NOT\_IN\_VIOLATION, IN\_VIOLATION\_OVERRIDDEN, IN\_VIOLATION]                                                              |
| `componentVersionStatusCounts[].value`                          | `Number` | False    | The number of components holding that status.                                                                                                                      |

#### Policy Status Representation

This is the overall policy status of a BOM Component. If the component is not violating any policies it will read: NOT_IN_VIOLATION or IN_VIOLATION_OVERRIDDEN. If the
component is violating one or more policies, the BOM Component status will read: IN_VIOLATION.

V7

```none
{
  "approvalStatus" : "IN_VIOLATION",
  "_meta" : {
    "allow" : [ "GET", "PUT" ],
    "href" : "https://...",
    "links" : [ ]
  }
}
```

*Table 286. Fields*

| Path             | Type     | Required | Description                                                                                                           |
| ---------------- | -------- | -------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `approvalStatus` | `String` | True     | The approval status of the component. Possible Values: [NOT\_IN\_VIOLATION, IN\_VIOLATION\_OVERRIDDEN, IN\_VIOLATION] |

#### Policy Rules Representation

V7

```none
{
  "totalCount" : 1,
  "items" : [ {
    "name" : "policy name",
    "description" : "policy description",
    "enabled" : true,
    "overridable" : true,
    "severity" : "MAJOR",
    "expression" : {
      "operator" : "AND",
      "expressions" : [ {
        "name" : "SINGLE_LICENSE",
        "operation" : "EQ",
        "parameters" : {
          "values" : [ "https://.../licenses/00000000-0010-0000-0000-000000000000" ]
        },
        "developerScanExpression" : false
      } ]
    },
    "createdAt" : "2026-06-17T15:26:54.856Z",
    "createdBy" : "user",
    "createdByUser" : "https://...",
    "updatedAt" : "2026-06-17T15:26:54.856Z",
    "updatedBy" : "user",
    "updatedByUser" : "https://...",
    "policyApprovalStatus" : "IN_VIOLATION",
    "comment" : "comment",
    "overrideExpiresAt" : "2026-06-24T15:26:54.856Z",
    "_meta" : {
      "allow" : [ "GET" ],
      "href" : "https://...",
      "links" : [ ]
    }
  } ],
  "appliedFilters" : [ ],
  "_meta" : {
    "allow" : [ "GET" ],
    "href" : "https://...",
    "links" : [ ]
  }
}
```

*Table 290. Fields*

| Path                                                       | Type      | Required | Description                                                                                                                                     |
| ---------------------------------------------------------- | --------- | -------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `totalCount`                                               | `Number`  | True     | The total number of elements available in the result set                                                                                        |
| `items[]`                                                  | `Array`   | True     | The specific sub-set of policy rules requested                                                                                                  |
| `items[].name`                                             | `String`  | True     | The general identifier of the policy.                                                                                                           |
| `items[].description`                                      | `String`  | False    | Summary of what the policy represents.                                                                                                          |
| `items[].enabled`                                          | `Boolean` | True     | Whether or not the policy is active.                                                                                                            |
| `items[].overridable`                                      | `Boolean` | True     | Whether or not the policy can be overridden.                                                                                                    |
| `items[].severity`                                         | `String`  | True     | The level of impact the policy has. Possible Values: [OK, UNSPECIFIED, TRIVIAL, MINOR, MAJOR, CRITICAL, BLOCKER]                                |
| `items[].expression`                                       | `Object`  | True     | The condition required to violate the policy.                                                                                                   |
| `items[].expression.operator`                              | `String`  | True     | The logical operator of the expression. Possible Values: [AND, OR]                                                                              |
| `items[].expression.expressions[]`                         | `Array`   | True     | The conditions required to violate the policy.                                                                                                  |
| `items[].expression.expressions[].name`                    | `String`  | True     | What the expression is evaluating against.                                                                                                      |
| `items[].expression.expressions[].operation`               | `String`  | True     | The boolean condition for the expression.                                                                                                       |
| `items[].expression.expressions[].parameters`              | `Object`  | True     | The parameters for the expression.                                                                                                              |
| `items[].expression.expressions[].parameters.values[]`     | `Array`   | True     | The parameter values for the expression.                                                                                                        |
| `items[].expression.expressions[].developerScanExpression` | `Boolean` | True     | Whether this expression is dev scan supported.                                                                                                  |
| `items[].createdAt`                                        | `String`  | True     | The date/time the policy was created.                                                                                                           |
| `items[].createdBy`                                        | `String`  | True     | The username who created the policy.                                                                                                            |
| `items[].createdByUser`                                    | `String`  | True     | URL for the resource representing the policy creator.                                                                                           |
| `items[].updatedAt`                                        | `String`  | False    | The date/time the policy was last updated.                                                                                                      |
| `items[].updatedBy`                                        | `String`  | False    | The username who last updated the policy.                                                                                                       |

| `items[].comment`                                          | `String`  | False    | The comment created by the last user to update the component’s policy status.                                                                   |

### BOM Component Issue Endpoints

BOM component issue endpoints are usually used in conjunction with automation.

#### Listing a Project Version’s BOM Component Issues

V6

**Request**

```http
GET /api/projects/{projectId}/versions/{projectVersionId}/issues
Accept: application/vnd.blackducksoftware.bill-of-materials-6+json
```

*Table 294. Parameters*

| Parameter | Required            | Description                                                                                                                         |
| --------- | ------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `offset`  | False (Default: 0)  | The number of results to skip from the beginning of the available set                                                               |
| `limit`   | False (Default: 10) | The maximum number of results to read from the available set                                                                        |
| `sort`    | False               | A specification of one or more fields to sort results by. Of format `<field> [asc | desc]`. Sortable Fields: [issueid, projectname] |

**Response**

The corresponding [List BOM component issue representation](#list-bom-component-issue-representation)

```none
}
```

| `uris[]`  | `Array`  | True     | Uris of the tar file representing the container                                      |

## Components

Components are general classifications of a collection of reusable code that is edited and released under a single label

### Component Endpoints

#### Creating a Custom Component

Creates a new component and component version within the application

V4

**Request**

```http
POST /api/components
Content-Type: application/vnd.blackducksoftware.component-detail-4+json
```

```none
{
  "name" : "name",
  "description" : "description",
  "url" : "https://...",
  "version" : {
    "versionName" : "v1.0",
    "releasedOn" : "2026-06-17T15:27:45.945Z",
    "license" : {
      "type" : "DISJUNCTIVE",
      "licenses" : [ ],
      "license" : "https://..."
    },
    "notes" : "notes",
    "approvalStatus" : "UNREVIEWED",
    "origin" : {
      "externalNamespace" : "maven",
      "externalId" : "originId",
      "versionName" : "versionName",
      "packageUrl" : "purl"
    }
  },
  "notes" : "notes",
  "approvalStatus" : "UNREVIEWED",
  "primaryLanguage" : "Java",
  "logo" : {
    "smallLogoUrl" : "https://.../small.png",
    "mediumLogoUrl" : "https://.../medium.png"
  }
}
```

*Table 358. Fields*

| Path                               | Type     | Required | Description                                                                                                                                                                          |
| ---------------------------------- | -------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `name`                             | `String` | True     | The general identifier of the component                                                                                                                                              |
| `description`                      | `String` | False    | Summary of what the component represents                                                                                                                                             |
| `url`                              | `String` | False    | URL where more information about the component is available                                                                                                                          |
| `version`                          | `Object` | True     | Values to initialize the first version of the project with                                                                                                                           |
| `version.versionName`              | `String` | True     | The name of the initial version to create                                                                                                                                            |

| `version.approvalStatus`           | `String` | False    | The level of approval that has been given to use the component version. Possible Values: [UNREVIEWED, IN\_REVIEW, REVIEWED, APPROVED, CONDITIONALLY\_APPROVED, REJECTED, DEPRECATED] |

| `version.origin.packageUrl`        | `String` | False    | Origin’s package url of this component version                                                                                                                                       |
| `notes`                            | `String` | False    | Notes regarding the usage of this component                                                                                                                                          |
| `approvalStatus`                   | `String` | True     | The level of approval that has been given to use the component. Possible Values: [UNREVIEWED, IN\_REVIEW, REVIEWED, APPROVED, LIMITED\_APPROVAL, REJECTED, DEPRECATED]               |
| `primaryLanguage`                  | `String` | False    | The primary language the component is written in                                                                                                                                     |
| `logo`                             | `Object` | False    | A logo for the component                                                                                                                                                             |
| `logo.smallLogoUrl`                | `String` | False    | A URL pointing to a small sized logo image                                                                                                                                           |

#### Searching Components

V4

**Request**


*Table 359. Parameters*

| Parameter | Required            | Description                                                                                                                                          |

| `offset`  | False (Default: 0)  | The number of results to skip from the beginning of the available set                                                                                |

| `sort`    | False               | A specification of one or more fields to sort results by. Of format `<field> [asc | desc]`. Sortable Fields: [componentname, versionname]            |
| `q`       | True                | A specification of search terms to filter results by. Of format `<field1>:<value1>,…​`. Searchable Fields: [id, external namespaces (ex: cpe,maven)] |

Searching by external ID can be specified in multiple forms as the `q` parameter. Parameter values are of forms demonstrated by the following examples:

```none
id:maven|org.apache.logging.log4j|log4j-core|2.4.1

rubygems:nokogiri/1.4.3.1
ubuntu:wmload/0.9.7-1
```

```http
Link: </components>;rel="self"
Allow: GET,POST
Content-Type: application/vnd.blackducksoftware.component-detail-4+json
Content-Length: 595

{
  "totalCount" : 1,
  "items" : [ {
    "componentName" : "name",
    "versionName" : "1.0",

    "component" : "/components/67a8f0ee-6991-4873-bc15-4bb9984072c9",

  } ],
  "appliedFilters" : [ ],

  }
}
```
