#### Updating a Component Custom Field

This endpoint updates the saved value in a custom field for a given component. The acceptable format of the values field varies depending on the data type of the custom field:

- For BOOLEAN custom fields this should be an array of a single string, 'true' or 'false'.

- For DATE custom fields this should be an array of a single string, in the date format yyyy-MM-dd’T’HH:mm:ss.SSS’Z' (i.e. 2019-04-25T09:57:21.051Z)

- For MULTISELECT custom fields this should be an array of hrefs to the options which have been selected.

- For all other types of fields with options this should be an array of a single href to the selected option.

- For all other types of fields without options this should be an array of a single plain string to store.

V5

**Request**

```http
PUT /api/components/{componentId}/custom-fields/{customFieldId}
Accept: application/vnd.blackducksoftware.component-detail-5+json
Content-Type: application/vnd.blackducksoftware.component-detail-5+json
```

```none
{
  "values" : [ "New Value" ]
}
```

*Table 374. Fields*

| Path     | Type    | Required | Description                                                       |
| -------- | ------- | -------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `values` | `Array` | True     | The new data to store in the custom field for the given component |

**Response**

The updated [component custom field representation](#component-custom-field-representation)

#### Component Custom Field Representation

Component custom field representations from the list, single read, and other responses follow a consistent form:

V5

```none
{
  "position" : 0,
  "label" : "Custom Field",
  "description" : "This is a description.",
  "type" : "TEXT",
  "active" : true,
  "values" : [ "value" ],
  "required" : false,
  "_meta" : {
    "allow" : [ "GET", "PUT" ],
    "href" : "https://...",
    "links" : [ ]
  }
}
```

*Table 375. Fields*

| Path          | Type      | Required | Description                                                                                                      |
| ------------- | --------- | -------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `position`    | `Number`  | True     | The location of the object within the component’s list of custom fields                                          |
| `label`       | `String`  | True     | The name of the custom field                                                                                     |
| `description` | `String`  | False    | A more detailed description of the custom field                                                                  |
| `type`        | `String`  | True     | The datatype of the custom field. Possible Values: [TEXT, TEXTAREA, DROPDOWN, RADIO, MULTISELECT, BOOLEAN, DATE] |
| `active`      | `Boolean` | True     | Whether the custom field is active or not. Inactive custom fields are not displayed in the UI                    |
| `values`      | `Array`   | False    | The data stored in the custom field for this specific component. Will be null if there is no data stored         |
| `required`    | `Boolean` | True     | Whether the custom field is required or not                                                                      |
| `_meta`       | `Object`  | True     | Meta data associated with the representation, as described in [Meta Data](#metadata)                             |

*Table 376. Links*

| Relation                   | Description                                                                                                                     |
| -------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `custom-field-option-list` | Resource listing options associated with this custom field. Present only for custom fields whose type supports creating options |

V5

```none

  "releasedOn" : "2026-06-17T15:27:42.541Z",
  "approvalStatus" : "UNREVIEWED",
  "license" : {
    "type" : "DISJUNCTIVE",
    "licenses" : [ {
      "license" : "/components/3293af3a-afae-4b13-9f5e-866db38f0ad6/versions/86653f1f-6eeb-4905-8dfb-60e738d907d5/licenses/00000000-0010-0000-0000-000000000000",
      "licenses" : [ ],
      "name" : "Unknown License",
      "ownership" : "UNKNOWN",
      "licenseDisplay" : "Unknown License"
    } ],
    "licenseDisplay" : "Unknown License"
  },
  "componentHash" : {
    "componentHash" : "",
    "algorithm" : ""
  },
  "source" : "KB",
  "type" : "COMPONENT",
  "additionalHomepages" : [ ],
  "migrated" : false,
  "_meta" : {
    "allow" : [ "GET", "PUT" ],
    "href" : "https://...",
    "links" : [ {
      "rel" : "references",
      "href" : "https://..."
    }, {

    }, {
```

| Path                                           | Type      | Required | Description                                                                                                                                                                          |

#### Updating a Component Version Custom Field

This endpoint updates the saved value in a custom field for a given component version. The acceptable format of the values field varies depending on the data type of the custom field:

- For BOOLEAN custom fields this should be an array of a single string, 'true' or 'false'.

- For DATE custom fields this should be an array of a single string, in the date format yyyy-MM-dd’T’HH:mm:ss.SSS’Z' (i.e. 2019-04-25T09:57:21.051Z)

- For MULTISELECT custom fields this should be an array of hrefs to the options which have been selected.

- For all other types of fields with options this should be an array of a single href to the selected option.

- For all other types of fields without options this should be an array of a single plain string to store.

V5

**Request**

```http
PUT /api/components/{componentId}/versions/{componentVersionId}/custom-fields/{customFieldId}
Accept: application/vnd.blackducksoftware.component-detail-5+json
Content-Type: application/vnd.blackducksoftware.component-detail-5+json
```

```none
{
  "values" : [ "New Value" ]
}
```

*Table 408. Fields*

| Path     | Type    | Required | Description                                                               |
| -------- | ------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `values` | `Array` | True     | The new data to store in the custom field for the given component version |

**Response**

The updated [component version custom field representation](#component-version-custom-field-representation)

#### Component Version Custom Field Representation

Component version custom field representations from the list, single read, and other responses follow a consistent form:

V5

```none
{
  "position" : 0,
  "label" : "Custom Field",
  "description" : "This is a description.",
  "type" : "TEXT",
  "active" : true,
  "values" : [ "value" ],
  "required" : false,
  "_meta" : {
    "allow" : [ "GET", "PUT" ],
    "href" : "https://...",
    "links" : [ ]
  }
}
```

*Table 409. Fields*

| Path          | Type      | Required | Description                                                                                                      |
| ------------- | --------- | -------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `position`    | `Number`  | True     | The location of the object within the component version’s list of custom fields                                  |
| `label`       | `String`  | True     | The name of the custom field                                                                                     |
| `description` | `String`  | False    | A more detailed description of the custom field                                                                  |
| `type`        | `String`  | True     | The datatype of the custom field. Possible Values: [TEXT, TEXTAREA, DROPDOWN, RADIO, MULTISELECT, BOOLEAN, DATE] |
| `active`      | `Boolean` | True     | Whether the custom field is active or not. Inactive custom fields are not displayed in the UI                    |
| `values`      | `Array`   | False    | The data stored in the custom field for this specific component version. Will be null if there is no data stored |
| `required`    | `Boolean` | True     | Whether the custom field is required or not                                                                      |
| `_meta`       | `Object`  | True     | Meta data associated with the representation, as described in [Meta Data](#metadata)                             |

*Table 410. Links*

| Relation                   | Description                                                                                                                     |
| -------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `custom-field-option-list` | Resource listing options associated with this custom field. Present only for custom fields whose type supports creating options |

#### Reading a Component Origin’s Transitive Upgrade Guidance

This response also provides guidance on what to update to, but takes into account risk from the transitive dependencies of an origin. It it recommended to favor the update guidance endpoint unless transitive dependencies are known to exist for performance reasons.

### License Endpoints

#### Creating a License

Creates a new license within the application

V5

**Request**

```http
POST /api/licenses
Content-Type: application/vnd.blackducksoftware.component-detail-5+json
Accept: application/vnd.blackducksoftware.component-detail-5+json
```

```none
{
  "name" : "name",
  "licenseFamily" : "https://.../license-families/{licenseFamilyId}",
  "text" : "license text",
  "licenseStatus" : "UNREVIEWED",
  "notes" : "notes",
  "expirationDate" : "2026-06-17T15:27:48.555Z"
}
```

| `notes`          | `String` | False    | The license’s notes                                                                                                                              |

```http
  "updatedCopyright" : "Copyright &#169; 2021\n</body>\n",
  "active" : true,
```
```none
  "source" : "KB_MODIFIED",
```

```http
    "allow" : [ "PUT" ],
    "href" : "https://...",

  }
```
```none
} ]
```

Notifications are records of application events of interest to end users

```http
Accept: application/vnd.blackducksoftware.notification-4+json
```

| `limit`     | False (Default: 10) | The maximum number of results to read from the available set                                                                                   |
| `sort`      | False               | A specification of one or more fields to sort results by. Of format `<field> [asc | desc]`. Sortable Fields: [createdat, type]                 |
| `filter`    | False               | A specification of properties to [filter](#filtering) results by. Of format `<filterKey>:<filterValue>`. Supported Filters: [notificationType] |
| `startDate` | False               | Reduces returned resources to those created after/at the indicated [timestamp](#schema)                                                        |

### Reading a Single Notification

V4

**Request**

```http
GET /api/notifications/{notificationId}
Accept: application/vnd.blackducksoftware.notification-4+json
```

**Response**

The corresponding [notification representation](#notification-representation)

### Notification Representation

Notification representations from the list, single read, and other responses follow a consistent form:

V4

```none
{
  "content" : { },
  "contentType" : "application/json",
  "type" : "VULNERABILITY",
  "createdAt" : "2026-06-17T15:29:22.554Z",
  "_meta" : {
    "allow" : [ "GET" ],
    "href" : "https://...",
    "links" : [ ]
  }
}
```

*Table 545. Fields*

| Path          | Type     | Required | Description                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| ------------- | -------- | -------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `type`        | `String` | True     | The category of notification represented. Possible Values: [POLICY\_OVERRIDE, RULE\_VIOLATION, VULNERABILITY, LICENSE\_LIMIT, RULE\_VIOLATION\_CLEARED, PROJECT, PROJECT\_VERSION, BOM\_EDIT, VERSION\_BOM\_CODE\_LOCATION\_BOM\_COMPUTED, COMPONENT\_UNKNOWN\_VERSION] |
| `createdAt`   | `String` | True     | The date/time when the notification was created                                                                                                                                                          |
| `content`     | `Object` | True     | JSON content specific to the [notification type](#notification-type-data-representation)                                                                                                                 |
| `contentType` | `String` | True     | The content type of the notification                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `_meta`       | `Object` | True     | Meta data associated with the representation, as described in [Meta Data](#metadata)                                                                                                                     |

### Listing User Notifications

V4

**Request**

```http
GET /api/users/{userId}/notifications
Accept: application/vnd.blackducksoftware.notification-4+json
```

*Table 546. Parameters*

| Parameter   | Required            | Description                                                                                                                                                                |
| ----------- | ------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `offset`    | False (Default: 0)  | The number of results to skip from the beginning of the available set                                                                                                      |
| `limit`     | False (Default: 10) | The maximum number of results to read from the available set                                                                                                               |
| `sort`      | False               | A specification of one or more fields to sort results by. Of format `<field> [asc | desc]`. Sortable Fields: [notification.createdOn]                                      |
| `filter`    | False               | A specification of properties to [filter](#filtering) results by. Of format `<filterKey>:<filterValue>`. Supported Filters: [notificationState, created, notificationType] |
| `startDate` | False               | Reduces returned resources to those created after/at the indicated [timestamp](#schema)                                                                                    |
| `endDate`   | False               | Reduces returned resources to those created before/at the indicated [timestamp](#schema)                                                                                   |

*Table 547. Filters*

| Filter                  | Description                                                                                                                    |
| ----------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `notificationCreatedAt` | Allows filtering results by the value of the `createdAt` field. Allowed values: [ONE\_DAY, THREE\_DAYS, ONE\_WEEK, ONE\_MONTH] |
| `notificationState`     | Allows filtering results by the value of the `state` field                                                                     |
| `notificationType`      | Allows filtering results by the value of the `type` field                                                                      |

**Response**

```http
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Link: </users/eb6276ef-3a09-4cdb-b78a-82b48b040c43/notifications>;rel="self"
Allow: GET
Content-Type: application/vnd.blackducksoftware.notification-4+json
Content-Length: 155

{
  "totalCount" : 0,
  "items" : [ ],
  "appliedFilters" : [ ],
  "_meta" : {
    "allow" : [ "GET" ],
    "href" : "https://...",
    "links" : [ ]
  }
}
```

*Table 548. Fields*

| Path         | Type     | Required | Description                                                                                              |
| ------------ | -------- | -------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `totalCount` | `Number` | True     | The total number of elements available in the result set                                                 |
| `items[]`    | `Array`  | True     | The specific sub-set of [user notification representations](#user-notification-representation) requested |
| `_meta`      | `Object` | True     | Meta data associated with the representation, as described in [Meta Data](#metadata)                     |

### Reading a Single User Notification

V4

**Request**

```http
GET /api/users/{userId}/notifications/{notificationId}
Accept: application/vnd.blackducksoftware.notification-4+json
```

**Response**

The corresponding [user notification representation](#user-notification-representation)

V4

**Request**

```http
PUT /api/users/{userId}/notifications/{notificationId}
Accept: application/vnd.blackducksoftware.notification-4+json
Content-Type: application/vnd.blackducksoftware.notification-4+json
```

```none
{
  "notificationState" : "SEEN"
}
```

*Table 549. Fields*

| Path                | Type     | Required | Description                                                                              |
| ------------------- | -------- | -------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `notificationState` | `String` | True     | The state of the notification represented. Possible Values: [NEW, SEEN, VISITED, HIDDEN] |

**Response**

The updated [user notification representation](#user-notification-representation)

### User Notification Representation

User notification representations from the list, single read, and other responses follow a consistent form:

V4

```none
{
  "content" : { },
  "contentType" : "application/json",
  "type" : "VULNERABILITY",
  "createdAt" : "2026-06-17T15:29:22.828Z",
  "notificationState" : "NEW",
  "_meta" : {
    "allow" : [ "GET", "PUT" ],
    "href" : "https://...",
    "links" : [ ]
  }
}
```

*Table 550. Fields*

| Path                | Type     | Required | Description                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| ------------------- | -------- | -------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `type`              | `String` | True     | The category of notification represented. Possible Values: [POLICY\_OVERRIDE, RULE\_VIOLATION, VULNERABILITY, LICENSE\_LIMIT, RULE\_VIOLATION\_CLEARED, PROJECT, PROJECT\_VERSION, BOM\_EDIT, VERSION\_BOM\_CODE\_LOCATION\_BOM\_COMPUTED, COMPONENT\_UNKNOWN\_VERSION] |
| `notificationState` | `String` | True     | The state of the notification represented. Possible Values: [NEW, SEEN, VISITED, HIDDEN]                                                                                                                 |
| `createdAt`         | `String` | True     | The date/time when the notification was created                                                                                                                                                          |
| `content`           | `Object` | True     | JSON content specific to the [notification type](#notification-type-data-representation)                                                                                                                 |
| `contentType`       | `String` | True     | The content type of the notification                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `_meta`             | `Object` | True     | Meta data associated with the representation, as described in [Meta Data](#metadata)                                                                                                                     |

#### Notification Type-Specific Data

Each notification has a notification type field, which indicates what occurred within the application. Each event type has a unique data payload associated with it

##### BOM_EDIT

## Announcements

Announcements are notices from system administrators to users. There are 4 types of announcements that are shown to users at different times.

1. Login Announcements: Shown before a user authenticates with the system.

2. Welcome Announcements: Shown when a user accesses the system. This only happens once per session. The system administrator can let
users suppress their display in future sessions.

3. Banner Announcements: Shown in the banner of the users’s window.

4. Footer Announcements: Shown in the footer of the user’s window.

While there are several types of Announcements, the API’s to get and manage Announcements are identical for
the different announcement types.

### Create Login Announcement

V1

**Request**

```http
POST /api/manage-announcement/login
Content-Type: application/vnd.blackducksoftware.system-announcement-1+json
Accept: application/vnd.blackducksoftware.system-announcement-1+json
```

## Policies

### Creating a Policy

Creates a new policy within the application

V5

**Request**

```http
POST /api/policy-rules
Content-Type: application/vnd.blackducksoftware.policy-5+json
```

```none
{
  "name" : "ruleName",
  "description" : "ruleDescription",
  "enabled" : true,
  "overridable" : true,
  "severity" : "CRITICAL",
  "category" : "LICENSE",
  "scanModes" : [ "FULL" ],
  "expression" : {
    "operator" : "AND",
    "expressions" : [ {
      "name" : "COMPONENT_USAGE",
      "operation" : "EQ",
      "parameters" : {
        "values" : [ "DYNAMICALLY_LINKED" ]
      },
      "developerScanExpression" : false
    } ]
  }
}
```

*Table 587. Fields*

| Path                                           | Type      | Required              | Description                                                                                                                |
| ---------------------------------------------- | --------- | --------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `name`                                         | `String`  | True                  | The general identifier of the policy                                                                                       |
| `description`                                  | `String`  | True                  | Summary of what the policy represents                                                                                      |
| `enabled`                                      | `Boolean` | True                  | Whether or not the policy is active                                                                                        |
| `overridable`                                  | `Boolean` | True                  | Whether or not the policy can be overridden                                                                                |
| `severity`                                     | `String`  | True                  | The level of impact the policy has. Possible Values: [OK, UNSPECIFIED, TRIVIAL, MINOR, MAJOR, CRITICAL, BLOCKER]           |
| `category`                                     | `String`  | True                  | The category for which the policy will belong. Possible Values: [COMPONENT, LICENSE, OPERATIONAL, SECURITY, UNCATEGORIZED] |
| `scanModes`                                    | `Array`   | False (Default: FULL) | The type of evaluations for which the policy will run. Possible Values: [FULL, RAPID]                                      |
| `expression`                                   | `Object`  | True                  | The condition required to violate the policy                                                                               |
| `expression.operator`                          | `String`  | True                  | The logical operator of the expression. Possible Values: [AND, OR]                                                         |
| `expression.expressions[]`                     | `Array`   | True                  | The conditions required to violate the policy                                                                              |
| `expression.expressions[].name`                | `String`  | True                  | What the expression is evaluating against                                                                                  |
| `expression.expressions[].operation`           | `String`  | True                  | The boolean condition for the expression                                                                                   |
| `expression.expressions[].parameters`          | `Object`  | True                  | The parameters for the expression                                                                                          |
| `expression.expressions[].parameters.values[]` | `Array`   | True                  | The parameter values for the expression                                                                                    |

**Response**

```http
HTTP/1.1 201 Created
Location: /policy-rules/e855cc35-75d2-4d11-af74-ab92c93cb467
Link: </policy-rules/e855cc35-75d2-4d11-af74-ab92c93cb467>;rel="self"
Allow: DELETE,GET,PUT
```

**Response Headers**

| Name       | Description                                                            |
| ---------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `Location` | Header containing a link to the constructed policy resource’s location |

## Reports

### Project Version Report Endpoints

#### Creating a Project Version SBOM Report

V5

**Request**

```http
POST /api/projects/{projectId}/versions/{projectVersionId}/sbom-reports
Content-Type: application/vnd.blackducksoftware.report-5+json
```

```none
{
  "reportFormat" : "JSON",
  "specification" : "SPDX_22",
  "template" : "https://.../api/sbom-templates/<templateId>"
}
```

*Table 597. Fields*

| Path            | Type     | Required | Description                                                                                                                                          |
| --------------- | -------- | -------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `reportFormat`  | `String` | True     | The format of the SBOM report to generate. Possible Values: [JSON, RDF, TAGVALUE, YAML]                                                              |
| `specification` | `String` | True     | The type of the SBOM report to generate. Possible Values: [SPDX\_30, SPDX\_23, SPDX\_22, CYCLONEDX\_16, CYCLONEDX\_15, CYCLONEDX\_14, CYCLONEDX\_13] |
| `template`      | `String` | False    | URL to SBOM template. If not provided default SBOM Template will be used.                                                                            |

- The value of the sbomType field determines which reportFormat values are valid.

- specification/sbomType "SPDX_22" or "SPDX_23" allows reportFormat values of "JSON", "RDF", "TAGVALUE" or "YAML".

- specification/sbomType "CYCLONEDX_13", or "CYCLONEDX_14", or "CYCLONEDX_15" or "CYCLONEDX_16" allows reportFormat values of "JSON".

- functionality of "includeSubprojects" is moved to [SBOM Templates](#sbom).

**Response**

```http
HTTP/1.1 201 Created
Location: /projects/2e4dfba0-aeb3-46f2-bb7a-d50cac0f9ca5/versions/b4f5afce-e84a-4d13-831c-64ba0e83b7d8/reports/4de53cd2-ade5-4725-b69d-aa8f814d4410
Link: </projects/2e4dfba0-aeb3-46f2-bb7a-d50cac0f9ca5/versions/b4f5afce-e84a-4d13-831c-64ba0e83b7d8/reports/4de53cd2-ade5-4725-b69d-aa8f814d4410>;rel="self"

Link: </projects/2e4dfba0-aeb3-46f2-bb7a-d50cac0f9ca5/versions/b4f5afce-e84a-4d13-831c-64ba0e83b7d8/reports/4de53cd2-ade5-4725-b69d-aa8f814d4410/download>;rel="download"
Allow: DELETE,GET
```

#### Creating a LTS Project Version SBOM Report

V5

**Request**

```http

Content-Type: application/vnd.blackducksoftware.report-5+json
```

```none
{
  "reportFormat" : "JSON",

}
```

*Table 627. Fields*

| Path            | Type     | Required | Description                                                                                                                                          |
| --------------- | -------- | -------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `reportFormat`  | `String` | True     | The format of the SBOM report to generate. Possible Values: [JSON, RDF, TAGVALUE, YAML]                                                              |
| `specification` | `String` | True     | The type of the SBOM report to generate. Possible Values: [SPDX\_30, SPDX\_23, SPDX\_22, CYCLONEDX\_16, CYCLONEDX\_15, CYCLONEDX\_14, CYCLONEDX\_13] |
| `template`      | `String` | False    | URL to SBOM template. If not provided default SBOM Template will be used.                                                                            |

- The value of the sbomType field determines which reportFormat values are valid.

- specification/sbomType "SPDX_22" or "SPDX_23" allows reportFormat values of "JSON", "RDF", "TAGVALUE" or "YAML".

- specification/sbomType "CYCLONEDX_13", or "CYCLONEDX_14", or "CYCLONEDX_15" or "CYCLONEDX_16" allows reportFormat values of "JSON".

## Scans

Scans are operations which determine what components of note a given project version is using.

Scans on a given resource are grouped into "code locations", one or more of which may be assigned to a given project version. Once assigned, a code location contributes its discovered components to that project version’s bill of materials.

#### Create Scan

This request is used to create a scan.

application/vnd.blackducksoftware.intelligent-persistence-scan-4+protobuf-jsonld

**Request**

```http
POST /api/intelligent-persistence-scans
Content-Type: application/vnd.blackducksoftware.intelligent-persistence-scan-4+protobuf-jsonld
```

**Request Headers**

| Name           | Description                                                           |
| -------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `X-BASE64-MD5` | Base64 encoded md5 value of the artifact associated with created scan |

**Request Body**

Request body is the bdio header in protobuf or jsonld format.

**Response**

```http
HTTP/1.1 201 Created
```

### Uploading Analysis Files

|  | This API is intended for use by Detect. While manually uploading individual analysis files generated by Detect in offline mode is supported, modifying or manually creating analysis files is not supported or recommended. If your organization plans to build a custom automated process to upload analysis files, please inform your account team, as future changes to the analysis file format or API could impact its stability. |
| --- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |

#### Uploading BDIO Files

|  | This endpoint is intended for use by the UI for uploading arbitrary BDIO files, not for scanning. For the latter, use the endpoints specific to each scan type. |
| --- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |

```http
POST /api/scan/data
Accept: application/vnd.blackducksoftware.bdio+json
Accept: application/ld+json
```

**Request**

File payloads may be uploaded via POST as standard for HTTP requests. If using `form-data` key/values to form requests, the file to be uploaded should use the key `file`.

The upload endpoint does not use the [standard JSON media types](#mediatypes), and instead uses either `application/vnd.blackducksoftware.bdio+json` or `application/ld+json`.

*Table 639. Parameters*

| Parameter | Required                 | Description                                                                                        |
| --------- | ------------------------ | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `mode`    | False (Default: replace) | How to combine the upload with previous uploads. Possible Values: [replace, start, append, finish] |

Uploads may be multi-part via the `mode` parameter. The available values produce the following behavior:

*Table 640. Upload Modes*

| Mode      | Description                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| --------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `append`  | The file is treated as a an addition to files from previous requests. Must be preceded by a request of mode `start`. Analysis will not begin until a request of mode `finish` is provided                |
| `finish`  | The file is treated as a completion of upload for a multi-part scan. Must be preceded by a request of mode `start` (which may be followed by multiple `append` mode requests). Analysis begins after the request completes. |
| `replace` | The file is treated as a new single-part scan, and analysis begins after the request completes                                                                                                           |
| `start`   | The file is treated as a new scan. Analysis will not begin until a request of mode `finish` is provided                                                                                                  |

#### Uploading SBOM Files

multipart/form-data

**Request**

```http
POST /api/scan/data
Content-Type: multipart/form-data; boundary=6o2knFse3p53ty9dmcQvWAIx1zInP11uCfbm
```

*Table 641. Parts*

| Part          | Description                                                                                                                                                                   |
| ------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `file`        | The name, SBOM format and content of the SBOM to be uploaded. Supported content types are `application/spdx` and `application/vnd.cyclonedx`. The file extension is required. |
| `projectName` | The name of the Project to map the scan to. Optional, required if `versionName` is defined.                                                                                   |
| `versionName` | The name of the Project Version to map the scan to. Optional, required if `projectName` is defined.                                                                           |
| `autocreate`  | Flag to autocreate components that were not matched by package Url. Optional.                                                                                                 |

#### Uploading Source Files

When permitted by the `ENABLE_SOURCE_UPLOADS` configuration variable source files can be uploaded for
display in the UI.

application/json

Multiple text files can be uploaded in a single call. Note that by default source for files
without snippet matches is discarded.

**Request**

```http
PUT /api/bulk-sources
Content-Type: application/json
Accept: application/json
```

```none
{
  "nodes" : [ {
    "content" : "aGVsbG8sIHdvcmxkCg==",
    "sha1" : "cd50d19784897085a8d0e3e413f8612b097c03f1"
  } ]
}
```

*Table 642. Fields*

| Path              | Type     | Required | Description                                 |
| ----------------- | -------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------- |
| `nodes`           | `Array`  | True     | The collection of files to upload.          |
| `nodes[].content` | `String` | True     | The base64-encoded file content.            |
| `nodes[].sha1`    | `String` | True     | The sha1sum of the plain-text file content. |

**Response**

```http
HTTP/1.1 202 Accepted
Content-Type: application/json
Content-Length: 137

{
  "uploadResults" : [ {
    "sha1" : "cd50d19784897085a8d0e3e413f8612b097c03f1",
    "uploaded" : true,
    "ErrorMessage" : ""
  } ]
}
```

*Table 643. Fields*

| Path                           | Type      | Required | Description                                         |
| ------------------------------ | --------- | -------- | --------------------------------------------------- |
| `uploadResults`                | `Array`   | True     | The list of results                                 |
| `uploadResults[].ErrorMessage` | `String`  | True     | The reason a file could not be uploaded.            |
| `uploadResults[].sha1`         | `String`  | True     | The sha1sum of the file.                            |
| `uploadResults[].uploaded`     | `Boolean` | True     | A boolean indicating whether the file was accepted. |

#### Multipart Upload of a Part of BDBA Data

application/vnd.blackducksoftware.multipart-upload-data-1+octet-stream

**Request**

Upload a portion of a multi-part upload of BDBA data.
Each portion can be uploaded in parallel, out of order, and repeatedly while the upload hasn’t been finished.

```http
PUT /api/storage/bdba/{id}/multipart
Content-Type: application/vnd.blackducksoftware.multipart-upload-data-1+octet-stream
```

*Table 647. Headers*

| Name             | Description                                                                                                       |
| ---------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `Content-Digest` | The MD5 checksum base 64 encoded of the current file content being uploaded.                                      |
| `Content-Range`  | The byte range start and end offsets in order to write the content in the correct location of the resulting file. |

**Response**

```http
HTTP/1.1 202 Accepted
```

#### Finishing Multipart Upload of BDBA Data

V1

**Request**

Finish a multi-part upload of BDBA data.

```http
POST /api/storage/bdba/{id}/multipart/completed
Content-Type: application/vnd.blackducksoftware.multipart-upload-finish-1+json
```

**Response**

```http
HTTP/1.1 204 No Content
```

#### Cancelling Multipart Upload of BDBA Data

Cancel a multi-part upload of BDBA data.

**Request**

```http
DELETE /api/storage/bdba/{id}/multipart
```

**Response**

```http
HTTP/1.1 204 No Content
```

V1


### Snippet matching endpoint

#### Finding matches for provided code snippet

Finds matches for code snippets. For plaintext snippets, the provided code snippet must be between 300 and 50,000 **non-whitespace** characters long. For fingerprint matching, the body content must contain at least 8 fingerprints.

text/plain

**Request**

```http
POST /api/snippet-matching
Content-Type: text/plain
```

```none
Code snippet content (must be between 300 and 50000 non-whitespace characters long)
```

### Rapid Scan Endpoints

#### Initialize a Rapid Scan

The initial request is used to initialize the scan with header and/or custom config.
The response to this request would include the link that can be used to make the subsequent requests as well as pull the results for the scan.

- Uses Content Type `application/vnd.blackducksoftware.developer-scan-1-ld-2+json` if only including stripping the needed header information to be part of the body.

- Uses Content Type `application/vnd.blackducksoftware.developer-scan-1-ld-2-yaml-1+zip` if including the archive of both header information and custom config to be part of the body. Note example custom config with policy overrides in body below.

application/vnd.blackducksoftware.developer-scan-1-ld-2-yaml-1+zip

**Request**

```http
POST /api/developer-scans
Content-Type: application/vnd.blackducksoftware.developer-scan-1-ld-2-yaml-1+zip
```

**Request Headers**

| Name               | Description                                 |
| ------------------ | ------------------------------------------- |
| `User-Agent`       | **Required** The tool used to scan          |
| `Content-Location` | An alternate location for the returned data |
| `Link`             | Link used to set the bdio context           |

**Request Body**

```none
{
    "https://blackducksoftware.github.io/bdio#hasCreationDateTime" : {
    "@type" : "http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#dateTime",
    "@value" : "2020-12-03T15:08:08.335-05:00[America/New_York]"
    }
}
---
policy:
  overrides:
  - policyName: "** Overall Score > 7.5 **"
    components:
    - name: Apache Camel
      version: 2.8.2
      vulnerabilities:
      - BDSA-2022-0001
      - CVE-2022-0002
    - name: Spring Boot
      version: 4.3-RC
    - name: Junit
  - policyName: "** Critical Severity > 0 **"
    components:
    - name: Apache Camel
```

**Response**

```http
HTTP/1.1 201 Created
Location: https://localhost/developer-scans/798f09cc-527e-4dd7-a383-2f0302df5418
```

V2

**Request**

```http
POST /api/developer-scans
Content-Type: application/vnd.blackducksoftware.developer-scan-1-ld-2+json
```

**Request Headers**

| Name               | Description                                 |
| ------------------ | ------------------------------------------- |
| `User-Agent`       | **Required** The tool used to scan          |
| `Content-Location` | An alternate location for the returned data |
| `Link`             | Link used to set the bdio context           |

**Request Body**

```none
{
  "https://blackducksoftware.github.io/bdio#hasCreationDateTime" : {
    "@type" : "http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#dateTime",
    "@value" : "2020-12-03T15:08:08.335-05:00[America/New_York]"
  }
}
```

**Response**

```http
HTTP/1.1 201 Created
Location: https://localhost/developer-scans/9bf166c5-8d90-4a57-b0bb-77b379808fc8
```

#### Upload Scan Data

This request is used to just ingest the data within the system. The chunk with the data would be part of the body.

V2

**Request**

```http
PUT /api/developer-scans/{scanId}
Content-Type: application/vnd.blackducksoftware.developer-scan-1-ld-2+json
```

**Request Headers**

| Name                   | Description                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| ---------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `X-BD-MODE`            | **Required** The mode of the current chunk that is being uploaded (Possible Values: Append, Finish)                                                                                                      |
| `X-BD-PROJECT-NAME`    | The BlackDuck project name                                                                                                                                                                               |
| `X-BD-VERSION-NAME`    | The BlackDuck project version name                                                                                                                                                                       |
| `X-BD-DOCUMENT-COUNT`  | The total number of the append chunks that are uploaded to the system with the data. This value will be used just for the finish chunk but does no harm to include in all the requests.                  |
| `X-BD-RAPID-SCAN-MODE` | The rapid scan evaluation mode. Default is ALL. Possible values: [ALL, BOM\_COMPARE, BOM\_COMPARE\_STRICT]. ALL evaluates all rapid scan type policy rules. BOM\_COMPARE additionally compares relevant policy rules to existing Project Version policy violations. BOM\_COMPARE\_STRICT only evaluates policy rules that can be compared to existing Project Version policy violations. |
| `Content-Location`     | An alternate location for the returned data                                                                                                                                                              |
| `User-Agent`           | **Required** The tool used to scan                                                                                                                                                                       |
| `Link`                 | Link used to set the bdio context                                                                                                                                                                        |

**Response**

```http
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
```

#### Fetch Result

The request to get the result for the scan. The response consists of components having policy violations. The client would be required to poll the results using this end-point. As the data is stored within Redis, the data might get expired within some timeout, so the results should be polled out before the data expires within Redis. The results would be paged.

V5

**Request**

```http
GET /api/developer-scans/{scanId}
Accept: application/vnd.blackducksoftware.scan-5+json
```

*Table 652. Parameters*

| Parameter | Required            | Description                                                           |
| --------- | ------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `offset`  | False (Default: 0)  | The number of results to skip from the beginning of the available set |
| `limit`   | False (Default: 10) | The maximum number of results to read from the available set          |

#### Fetch Full Result

The request to get the full result for the scan. The response consists of components having policy violations, components without policy violations but having security vulnerabilities, partially evaluated policies and non evaluated policies for the scan. The client would be required to poll the results using this end-point. As the data is stored within Redis with the same timeout as scan positive results.

V6

**Request**

```http
GET /api/developer-scans/{scanId}/full-result
Accept: application/vnd.blackducksoftware.scan-6+json
```

| Parameter                 | Required               | Description                                                                                                |
| ------------------------- | ---------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `offset`                  | False (Default: 0)     | The number of results to skip from the beginning of the available set                                      |
| `limit`                   | False (Default: 10)    | The maximum number of results to read from the available set                                               |
| `nonVulnerableComponents` | False (Default: false) | Display all the components results from scan irrespective of policy violations or security vulnerabilities |

### Repository Scanning Endpoints

These API are intended for use by integrations that scan repositories.

#### Upload an artifact

Uploads of artifacts trigger scans automatically.

application/vnd.blackducksoftware.artifact-scan-data-1+octet-stream

**Request**

```http
POST /api/storage/artifacts/{serverId}/{artifactId}
Content-Type: application/vnd.blackducksoftware.artifact-scan-data-1+octet-stream
```

*Table 662. /storage/artifacts/{serverId}/{artifactId}*

| Parameter    | Description             |
| ------------ | ----------------------- |
| `serverId`   | Integration server uuid |
| `artifactId` | Scan artifact uuid      |

**Request Headers**

| Name             | Description              |
| ---------------- | ------------------------ |
| `Content-Length` | Optional content length. |

**Response**

```http
HTTP/1.1 201 Created
```

#### Download an artifact

**Request**

```http
GET /api/storage/artifacts/{serverId}/{artifactId}
```

*Table 663. /storage/artifacts/{serverId}/{artifactId}*

| Parameter    | Description             |
| ------------ | ----------------------- |
| `serverId`   | Integration server uuid |
| `artifactId` | Scan artifact uuid      |

**Response**

```http
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: application/octet-stream
Last-Modified: Wed, 17 Jun 2026 15:30:29 GMT
Content-Disposition: attachment; filename="ed269710-46f3-43a3-a9e0-c6866fdbba28"
```

*Table 664. Headers*

| Name                  | Description                                                                                        |
| --------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `Last-Modified`       | Last modification date of the artifact being downloaded.                                           |
| `Content-Disposition` | Note that the attachment file name is internally generated, *not* what was supplied during upload. |

#### Delete an artifact

**Request**

```http
DELETE /api/storage/artifacts/{serverId}/{artifactId}
```

*Table 665. /storage/artifacts/{serverId}/{artifactId}*

| Parameter    | Description             |
| ------------ | ----------------------- |
| `serverId`   | Integration server uuid |
| `artifactId` | Scan artifact uuid      |

**Response**

```http
HTTP/1.1 204 No Content
```

```none
  },
```

*Table 673. Fields*

| Path                                     | Type      | Required | Description                                                                          |

| `url`                                    | `String`  | True     | URL describing the location of the source                                            |
| `createdAt`                              | `String`  | True     | The date/time when the code location was created                                     |
| `updatedAt`                              | `String`  | True     | The date/time when the code location was updated                                     |
| `scanSize`                               | `Number`  | False    | The sum of the size(s) of all scans associated with the code location                |
| `mappedProjectVersion`                   | `String`  | False    | URL specifying the project version linked to the code location                       |
| `autoUnmappingStatus`                    | `Object`  | False    | Auto Unmapping Status of the Code location                                           |
| `autoUnmappingStatus.markedForUnmapping` | `Boolean` | False    | True if the system has marked the code location for future unmapping                 |
| `autoUnmappingStatus.unmappingDate`      | `String`  | False    | Time the system will unmap this Code Location                                        |
| `_meta`                                  | `Object`  | True     | Meta data associated with the representation, as described in [Meta Data](#metadata) |

| `components`  | Resource listing the Bill of Materials for the project version associated with the code location |
| `scan-data`   | A link to download the file that was scanned to create this code location                        |

#### Scan Summary Representation

Scan summary representations follow a consistent form:

V6

```none
{
  "serverVersion" : "",
  "scanState" : "SUCCESS",
  "transitionReason" : "COMPLETE",
  "statusMessage" : "Test Message",
  "createdAt" : "2026-06-17T15:30:12.318Z",
  "createdByUserName" : "testUser1Name",
  "scanSize" : 10000,
  "matchCount" : 0,
  "directoryCount" : 0,
  "fileCount" : 0,
  "baseDirectory" : ".",
  "hostName" : "hostName",
  "scanType" : "BDIO",
  "retainUnmatchedFiles" : true,
  "aiModelMatchCount" : 0,
  "_meta" : {
    "allow" : [ "GET" ],
    "href" : "https://...",
    "links" : [ {
      "rel" : "codelocation",
      "href" : "https://..."
    } ]
  },
  "updatedAt" : "1970-01-01T00:00:00.000Z"
}
```

*Table 683. Fields*

| Path                   | Type      | Required | Description                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| ---------------------- | --------- | -------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `scanState`            | `String`  | True     | Represents the current state the scan is in. Possible Values: [STARTED, SUCCESS, FAILURE]                                                                                                                |
| `transitionReason`     | `String`  | True     | Represents the reason for the scan’s current state. Possible Values: [TOOL\_SUBMISSION, USER\_UPLOAD, SCAN\_INGESTED, COMPLETE, CANCELLED, CLONED, SKIPPED, IDENTICAL\_RESCAN, ERROR\_TOOL, ERROR\_SCANNING, ERROR\_SAVING\_SCAN\_DATA, ERROR\_MATCHING, ERROR\_BUILDING\_BOM, ERROR] |
| `statusMessage`        | `String`  | True     | Human-readable message describing the analysis state                                                                                                                                                     |
| `createdAt`            | `String`  | True     | The date/time when the scan was created                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `updatedAt`            | `String`  | False    | The date/time when the scan was updated                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `createdByUserName`    | `String`  | False    | The name of the user who created the scan (first/last), or username                                                                                                                                      |

### Scan Tools

Black Duck provides operations to manage scan tools using standard HTTP requests.

#### Downloading Scan Tools

`HEAD` and `GET` requests can be used to download tool information and content. The request
and response from the two methods are identical except that HEAD requests do not return
body content, only headers.

To download a specific version specify the version number in the request path. To download
a compatible version specify `latest` and optionally supply an `Accept-Version` header.

**Request**

```http
GET /api/tools/{toolName}/versions/{version}/platforms/{platform}
```

*Table 700. /tools/{toolName}/versions/{version}/platforms/{platform}*

| Parameter  | Description                                                                                                       |
| ---------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `toolName` | Name of the tool to be downloaded, in 'name.ext' format.                                                          |
| `version`  | Version of the tool to be downloaded. Either a version number or the special value `latest` can be supplied.      |
| `platform` | The platform or architecture of the tool desired. Use `noarch` for platform-independent artifacts like jar files. |

*Table 701. Headers*

| Name             | Description                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| ---------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `Version`        | The version number of the tool that the client has already downloaded. If this is the same version that would be downloaded by this call a 304 NOT MODIFIED status will be returned.                     |
| `Accept-Version` | This header controls the server’s choice of version to return when `latest` is requested. It can contain an optional version number and/or upgrade level. If no version is supplied the value of the Version header will be used. Possible upgrade compatibility levels are: ANY, MAJOR, MINOR, PATCH, PRERELEASE, NONE. If no upgrade level is specified `MAJOR` will be used if a desired version could be inferred, otherwise `ANY` will be used. This header is only relevant when the version part of the request URL is `latest`. |

**Response**

```http
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
FileName: scan.cli_1.1.0_macosx.zip
Version: 1.1.0
Last-Modified: Wed, 17 Jun 2026 15:30:30 GMT
Link: <https://localhost/api/tools/scan.cli.zip/versions/1.1.0/platforms/macosx>;rel="self"
Allow: HEAD,GET,DELETE
Location: https://localhost/api/tools/scan.cli.zip/versions/1.1.0/platforms/macosx
Content-Disposition: attachment; filename="scan.cli_1.1.0_macosx.zip"
Content-Type: application/zip
```

*Table 702. Headers*

| Name                  | Description                                                                |
| --------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `FileName`            | The file name of downloaded tool, in 'name\_version\_platform.ext' format. |
| `Version`             | The version of the downloaded tool.                                        |
| `Last-Modified`       | Last modification date of the tool being downloaded.                       |
| `Content-Disposition` | This header indicates the file name for the attached content.              |

#### Uploading Scan Tools

Tools may be uploaded via `POST` requests using either `multipart/form-data` key/values where the file to be uploaded uses the key `file` or raw `application/octet-stream` data where the URL provides the tool information.

##### Uploading tools using `multipart/form-data`

multipart/form-data

**Request**

```http
POST /api/tools
Content-Type: multipart/form-data; boundary=6o2knFse3p53ty9dmcQvWAIx1zInP11uCfbm
```

| Part   | Description                                                                                                               |
| ------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |

```http
Allow: HEAD,GET,DELETE
Last-Modified: Wed, 17 Jun 2026 15:30:30 GMT
Version: 1.0.0
```

| Name            | Description                                                |
| --------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------- |
| `Last-Modified` | Header containing the last modification date for this tool |
| `Version`       | Header containing the uploaded tool’s version number       |
| `Location`      | Header containing a link to the tool resource’s location   |

#### Deleting Scan Tools

Tools may be removed from the server using `DELETE` requests, but default versions will be automatically recreated.
The path can be controlled to remove a single artifact, all artifacts for a tool version and platform, all
artifacts for a tool version, or even all artifacts for a tool.

##### Deleting a specific artifact or all artifacts for a tool

**Request**

```http
DELETE /api/tools/{toolName}
```

*Table 706. /tools/{toolName}*

| Parameter  | Description                                                                                                                                          |
| ---------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `toolName` | Tool name in 'name.ext' format to delete all artifacts for a tool or filename in 'name\_version\_platform.ext' format to delete a specific artifact. |

**Response**

```http
HTTP/1.1 204 No Content
```

##### Deleting all artifacts for a tool version

**Request**

```http
DELETE /api/tools/{toolName}/versions/{version}
```

*Table 707. /tools/{toolName}/versions/{version}*

| Parameter  | Description                                            |
| ---------- | ------------------------------------------------------ |
| `toolName` | Tool name in 'name.ext' format.                        |
| `version`  | Version of the tool whose artifacts should be deleted. |

**Response**

```http
HTTP/1.1 204 No Content
```

##### Deleting all artifacts for a tool version on a platform

**Request**

```http
DELETE /api/tools/{toolName}/versions/{version}/platforms/{platform}
```

*Table 708. /tools/{toolName}/versions/{version}/platforms/{platform}*

| Parameter  | Description                                                                                             |
| ---------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `toolName` | Tool name in 'name.ext' format.                                                                         |
| `version`  | Version of the tool.                                                                                    |
| `platform` | Platform of the artifact to be deleted. Use `noarch` for platform-independent artifacts like jar files. |

**Response**

```http
HTTP/1.1 204 No Content
```

#### Listing Tools

Tools may be listed from the server using `GET` requests. The results are returned sorted in a default order by provider, name, version and platform.

V1

```http
GET /api/tools

```

```http
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Link: </tools>;rel="self"
Allow: GET
Content-Type: application/vnd.blackducksoftware.tool-view-1+json
Content-Length: 517

{
  "totalCount" : 1,

    "provider" : "file",
    "name" : "scan.cli.zip",
    "version" : "2023.1.0-SNAPSHOT",

    "size" : 109480179,

    "_meta" : {
      "allow" : [ ],

    }
  } ],
  "appliedFilters" : [ ],
  "_meta" : {

  }
}
```

#### Downloading Detect

Download Detect artifact by conditionally redirecting the request to either repo (Black Duck hosting) or customized Detect uri (Internal hosting).

Optional header `Version` is the local client version of Detect.
If the client version is current with the version that admin configures, the endpoint will return a 304 NOT MODIFIED status code instead of redirecting.

application/java-archive

**Request**

```http
GET /api/tools/detect
```

*Table 710. Headers*

| Name      | Description                                                                                                                                                                            |
| --------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `Version` | The version number of the Detect that the client has already downloaded. If this is the same version that would be downloaded by this call a 304 NOT MODIFIED status will be returned. |

**Response**

```http
HTTP/1.1 302 Found
Content-Type: application/java-archive
Location: https://repo.blackduck.com/bds-integrations-release/com/synopsys/integration/synopsys-detect/8.6.0/synopsys-detect-8.6.0.jar
```

### Deprecated Endpoints

#### Uploading Binary Scan Data

|  | This endpoint is deprecated for removal as of 2025.1.0. Use POST api/storage/bdba/{id} instead. |

multipart/form-data

**Request**

Uploading binary scan data will initiate a scan.

```http
POST /api/uploads
Content-Type: multipart/form-data; boundary=6o2knFse3p53ty9dmcQvWAIx1zInP11uCfbm
```

*Table 716. Parts*

| Part               | Description                                                                                                        |
| ------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `projectName`      | The desired project name. If no such project exists one will be created.                                           |
| `version`          | The desired project version. If no such version exists one will be created.                                        |
| `fileupload`       | The binary file to be scanned.                                                                                     |
| `codeLocationName` | The code location name. If missing the original file name will be used. This part is optional.                     |
| `codeLocationUri`  | The code location uri. If missing a UUID urn will be generated from the code location name. This part is optional. |

**Response**

```http
HTTP/1.1 201 Created
Deprecation: true
BDS-Deprecation: Use V1 version of /storage/bdba/{id}
Location: https://localhost/api/scan/data/ba1cd8f5-df1f-4665-8d76-4c7603c97b09
ETag: "a048c92e-1e5c-4e55-bbd5-ff8f77708531"
```

*Table 717. Headers*

| Name       | Description                                                 |
| ---------- | ----------------------------------------------------------- |
| `Location` | A URL to view the scan results.                             |
| `ETag`     | A quoted string with the storage uuid assigned to the data. |

## Status

Statuses are information about the application - some examples are linking, job information, and registration.

### Registration Endpoints

#### Activating Registration

V4

**Request**

```http
POST /api/registration
Accept: application/vnd.blackducksoftware.status-4+json
Content-Type: application/vnd.blackducksoftware.status-4+json
```

```none
{
  "registrationId" : "registrationId"
}
```

*Table 727. Fields*

| Path             | Type     | Required | Description                                                        |
| ---------------- | -------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `registrationId` | `String` | True     | The registration ID/key to associate with the application instance |

**Response**

```http
HTTP/1.1 201 Created
Location: /registration
Link: </registration>;rel="self"
Allow: PUT,POST,GET
```

**Response Headers**

| Name       | Description                                                                  |
| ---------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `Location` | Header containing a link to the constructed registration resource’s location |

```none
{

}
```

**Request**

```http

```

```http
  } ],

  } ],
```

| Path                        | Type      | Required | Description                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| --------------------------- | --------- | -------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `registrationId`            | `String`  | False    | The registration ID/key associated with the application instance                                                                                                                                         |
| `state`                     | `String`  | False    | The overall validity state of the registration. Possible Values: [VALID, EXPIRED, INVALID, INCOMPLETE\_INSTALL, NETWORK\_FAILURE, NOT\_SET]                                                              |
| `features[]`                | `Array`   | True     | A collection of the enabled/licensed features on the application                                                                                                                                         |
| `features[].feature`        | `String`  | False    | Key indicated which of a defined set of features the object represents. Possible Values: [AI\_MODEL\_SCANNING, ARTIFACTORY\_INTEGRATION, BDSA, BINARY\_ANALYSIS, CONNECT\_AND\_SHARE, CONTAINER\_ANALYSIS, CRYPTO\_ALGORITHMS, CUSTOM\_SIGNATURES, DEEP\_VULNERABILITY\_INTELLIGENCE, DEPENDENCY\_SCANNING, ENHANCED\_VULNERABILITY\_ANALYSIS, FULL\_SNIPPET\_SCANS, GENERATIVE\_AI\_COMPLIANCE, ISCAN, MATCH\_AS\_A\_SERVICE, NOTIFICATIONS, OPSSIGHT, OSS\_ATTRIBUTION, OSS\_NOTICES\_REPORTS, POLICY\_MANAGEMENT, PROJECT\_MANAGEMENT, REST\_API, RISK\_MANAGEMENT, SBOM\_MANAGEMENT, SBOM\_SERVICE, SCA\_SCAN\_SERVICE, SCM\_INTEGRATION, SIGNATURE\_SCANNING, SNIPPET, VULNERABILITY\_EXPLOITABILITY\_EXCHANGE] |
| `features[].state`          | `String`  | False    | Value indicating the specific feature’s licensing status. Possible Values: [VALID, EXPIRED, NOT\_LICENSED]                                                                                               |
| `features[].warningValue`   | `Number`  | False    | The value at which it is recommended clients begin visibly warning end users of impending license limitations                                                                                            |
| `features[].limitValue`     | `Number`  | False    | The value at which the license will prevent/limit use of the associated feature                                                                                                                          |
| `features[].hidden`         | `Boolean` | True     | A boolean indicating whether this feature should be hidden in the UI                                                                                                                                     |
| `startDate`                 | `String`  | False    | The date/time the license as a whole will become valid                                                                                                                                                   |
| `expirationWarningDate`     | `String`  | False    | The date/time that the it is recommended clients begin visibily warning end users of the license as a whole expiring                                                                                     |
| `expirationDate`            | `String`  | False    | The date/time the license as a whole will become invalid and require renewal                                                                                                                             |
| `messages[]`                | `Array`   | True     | A collection of information on potential error states of the license                                                                                                                                     |
| `messages[].messageCode`    | `String`  | False    | One of a defined set of keys indicating the type of error described. Possible Values: [ACTIVATE\_REGISTRATION\_ERROR, DATE\_PARSING\_ERROR, EXPIRATION\_DATE\_WARNING, INSTALLATION\_INCOMPLETE\_ERROR, INVALID\_REGISTRATION\_ERROR, INVALID\_LICENSE\_USAGE\_WINDOW, NETWORK\_FAILURE\_ERROR, REFRESH\_REGISTRATION\_ERROR] |
| `messages[].message`        | `String`  | False    | User-readable description of the error                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `attributes[]`              | `Array`   | True     | A collection of various licensed attributes/limits governing use of the application                                                                                                                      |
| `attributes[].attribute`    | `String`  | False    | Key indicated which of a defined set of attributes the object represents. Possible Values: [CODEBASE\_MANAGED\_LINES\_OF\_CODE, INDEXED\_LINES\_OF\_CODE, MANAGED\_CODEBASE\_BYTES\_NEW, USER\_LIMIT, CUSTOM\_PROJECT\_LIMIT, PROJECT\_RELEASE\_LIMIT, CODE\_LOCATION\_LIMIT, CODE\_LOCATION\_BYTES\_LIMIT, LTS\_PROJECT\_VERSION\_LIMIT] |
| `attributes[].warningValue` | `Number`  | False    | The value at which it is recommended clients begin visibly warning end-users of impending license limitations                                                                                            |
| `attributes[].limitValue`   | `Number`  | False    | The value at which the license will prevent/limit use based on the associated attribute                                                                                                                  |
| `attributes[].currentValue` | `Number`  | False    | The current level of use for the attribute                                                                                                                                                               |
| `serviceStatus`             | `String`  | False    | Message representing any problems reading registration data                                                                                                                                              |
| `_meta`                     | `Object`  | True     | Meta data associated with the representation, as described in [Meta Data](#metadata)                                                                                                                     |

#### Job Representation

Job representations from the list, single read, and other responses follow a consistent form:

V4

```none
{
  "type" : "type",
  "status" : "COMPLETED",
  "jobEntityDescription" : "jobEntityDescriptionMessage",
  "progressData" : "progressData",
  "errorText" : "errorText",
  "startedAt" : "2026-06-17T15:28:50.300Z",
  "updatedAt" : "2026-06-17T15:28:50.300Z",
  "scheduledAt" : "2026-06-17T15:28:50.300Z",
  "finishedAt" : "2026-06-17T15:28:50.300Z",
  "_meta" : {
    "allow" : [ ],
    "links" : [ ]
  }
}
```

*Table 733. Fields*

| Path                   | Type     | Required | Description                                                                                                                        |
| ---------------------- | -------- | -------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `type`                 | `String` | True     | Key which indicates the function the job is performing                                                                             |
| `status`               | `String` | True     | The current state of the job. Possible Values: [SCHEDULED, DISPATCHED, RUNNING, SUSPENDED, TERMINATED, COMPLETED, SKIPPED, FAILED] |
| `jobEntityDescription` | `String` | False    | The description of the entity that started the job                                                                                 |
| `progressData`         | `String` | False    | Description of the progress made by the job                                                                                        |
| `errorText`            | `String` | False    | Description of any errors that happened attempting to run the job                                                                  |
| `startedAt`            | `String` | False    | The date/time the job was started                                                                                                  |
| `updatedAt`            | `String` | False    | The last date/time properties of the job were updated                                                                              |
| `scheduledAt`          | `String` | False    | The date/time the job was initially scheduled                                                                                      |
| `finishedAt`           | `String` | False    | The date/time the job finished                                                                                                     |
| `_meta`                | `Object` | True     | Meta data associated with the representation, as described in [Meta Data](#metadata)                                               |

*Table 734. Links*

| Relation     | Description                                                                                                                       |
| ------------ | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `entity`     | A link to the entity that started the job, if it exists                                                                           |
| `related-to` | If the job is related to another item (like a project version), a link to that item. May also contain a label for the linked item |

### Scan Readiness

The Scan Readiness status describes if Black Duck is ready to accept new scans.

V1

**Request**

```http
GET /api/scan-readiness
Accept: application/vnd.blackducksoftware.scan-readiness-1+json
```

**Response**

```http
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: application/json;charset=UTF-8
Content-Length: 202

{
  "readiness" : "ACCEPTING",
  "items" : [ {
    "id" : "9626b76f6f43",

    "versionId" : 1
  } ]
}
```

*Table 744. Fields*

| Path                | Type     | Required | Description                                                                                      |
