| `items`             | `Array`  | True     | The specific sub-set of readiness state of the compatible services.                              |
| `items[].id`        | `String` | False    | Unique identifier of the service.                                                                |
| `items[].service`   | `String` | False    | Name of the service.                                                                             |
| `items[].readiness` | `String` | False    | Readiness state of the service. Possible Values: [ACCEPTING, DEGRADED]                           |
| `items[].updatedAt` | `String` | False    | The Date/Time the status was last updated.                                                       |
| `items[].versionId` | `Number` | False    | Unique identifier of the version.                                                                |

### Certificate Expiration Check

The certificate expiration status describes if an authentication certificate used by Black Duck is about to expire.

application/json

**Request**

```http
GET /api/cert-expiration-checks/internal
Accept: application/json
```

**Response**

```http
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Allow: GET
Content-Type: application/json
Content-Length: 203

{
  "certificateName" : "Black Duck Server Internal Certificate",
  "expiryDate" : "2026-11-13T16:29:02.672Z",
  "timeLastChecked" : "2026-06-17T15:29:02.672Z",
  "expired" : false,
  "warning" : false
}
```

*Table 745. Fields*

| Path              | Type      | Required | Description                                                     |
| ----------------- | --------- | -------- | --------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `certificateName` | `String`  | True     | Name of the authentication certificate                          |
| `expiryDate`      | `String`  | True     | The 'notAfter' date from the validity period of the certificate |
| `timeLastChecked` | `String`  | True     | The time when expiry date was last checked                      |
| `warning`         | `Boolean` | True     | If certificate is going to expire soon                          |
| `expired`         | `Boolean` | True     | If certificate already expired                                  |

#### Assigned User Group Representation

User group assignment representations from the single read and list read responses follow a consistent form:

V4

```none
{
  "name" : "name",
  "externalName" : "externalName",
  "active" : true,
  "createdFrom" : "INTERNAL",
  "default" : false,
  "userGroup" : "/usergroups/d3e84f34-4096-4d4d-ab0f-f519e3437459",
  "_meta" : {
    "allow" : [ ],
    "href" : "https://...",
    "links" : [ {
      "rel" : "users",
      "href" : "https://..."
    }, {
      "rel" : "projects",
      "href" : "https://..."
    }, {
      "rel" : "roles",
      "href" : "https://..."
    } ]
  }
}
```

*Table 763. Fields*

| Path           | Type      | Required | Description                                                                          |
| -------------- | --------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `name`         | `String`  | True     | The name of the user group                                                           |
| `externalName` | `String`  | False    | Name used to identify the group within another system                                |
| `userGroup`    | `String`  | False    | URL to the representation of the user group                                          |
| `active`       | `Boolean` | False    | The active status of the user group                                                  |
| `createdFrom`  | `String`  | True     | The source of the user group                                                         |
| `default`      | `Boolean` | False    | The boolean value if the group is default or not                                     |
| `_meta`        | `Object`  | True     | Meta data associated with the representation, as described in [Meta Data](#metadata) |

*Table 764. Links*

| Relation   | Description                                                 |
| ---------- | ----------------------------------------------------------- |
| `users`    | URL representing the users assigned to the user group       |
| `projects` | URL representing the projects the user group is assigned to |
| `roles`    | URL representing the roles assigned to the user group       |

#### Assigned User Representation

User group assignment representations from the single read and list read responses follow a consistent form:

V4

```none
{
  "userName" : "userName",
  "externalUserName" : "externalUserName",
  "firstName" : "Firstname",
  "lastName" : "Lastname",
  "email" : "email@test.com",
  "type" : "EXTERNAL",
  "active" : true,
  "user" : "/users/ae9bc4a1-11f7-4248-8012-7baef91098d2",
  "mfaConfigured" : false,
  "_meta" : {
    "allow" : [ "DELETE", "GET" ],
    "href" : "https://...",
    "links" : [ ]
  }
}
```

*Table 795. Fields*

| Path               | Type      | Required | Description                                                                          |
| ------------------ | --------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `user`             | `String`  | True     | URL representing the assigned user                                                   |
| `userName`         | `String`  | True     | The general identifier of the user                                                   |
| `externalUserName` | `String`  | True     | The external name of the user                                                        |
| `firstName`        | `String`  | True     | The user’s first name                                                                |
| `lastName`         | `String`  | True     | The user’s last name                                                                 |
| `email`            | `String`  | True     | The user’s email address                                                             |
| `type`             | `String`  | True     | The type (internal, external) of the user                                            |
| `active`           | `Boolean` | True     | Whether or not the user is active                                                    |
| `mfaConfigured`    | `Boolean` | True     | Whether or not the user has MFA configured                                           |
| `_meta`            | `Object`  | True     | Meta data associated with the representation, as described in [Meta Data](#metadata) |

```http
  "registeredRedirectUris" : [ "http://uri" ],
```

| `accessTokenValiditySeconds`  | `Number` | True     | The access token validity period for this client. Accepted value is between '1800' - '86400' seconds                                          |

## Administration

The following endpoints allow administration of the Black Duck system as a whole. Typically only a system administrator will have permission to interact with these APIs.

### Application Settings

Application settings impact the overall behavior of the system, and can include analysis operation controls, review controls, and visual alterations.

#### Reading Analysis Settings

V6

**Request**

```http
GET /api/settings/analysis
Accept: application/vnd.blackducksoftware.admin-6+json
```

**Response**

```http
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Link: </settings/analysis>;rel="self"
Allow: PATCH,GET,PUT
Content-Type: application/vnd.blackducksoftware.admin-6+json
Content-Length: 241

{
  "customSignatureMatchDepth" : 1,
  "maximumSnippetFileSize" : 2,
  "fileDependencyAllowDupDepth" : 1,
  "minimumScanInterval" : 4,
  "_meta" : {
    "allow" : [ "GET", "PATCH", "PUT" ],
    "href" : "https://...",
    "links" : [ ]
  }
}
```

*Table 818. Fields*

| Path                          | Type     | Required | Description                                                                                                                                           |
| ----------------------------- | -------- | -------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `customSignatureMatchDepth`   | `Number` | True     | The depth in the file tree to analyze when creating custom signatures                                                                                 |
| `maximumSnippetFileSize`      | `Number` | True     | The maximum file size to analyze for snippet matches                                                                                                  |
| `fileDependencyAllowDupDepth` | `Number` | True     | The depth in the file dependency tree that allows duplicate components                                                                                |
| `minimumScanInterval`         | `Number` | True     | The minimum time interval (in hours) that should pass between the current scan and the latest successful scan to enable execution of the current scan |

### Custom Fields

Custom Fields are special data fields defined that can appear on various objects in the system. Users who can edit those objects can then save values into the custom fields. Custom Fields may be used to create policies, or just to save additional metadata alongside an object

#### Listing Custom Field Datatypes

V4

**Request**

```http
GET /api/custom-fields/types
Accept: application/vnd.blackducksoftware.admin-4+json
```

**Response**

```http
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Link: </custom-fields/types>;rel="self"
Allow: GET
Content-Type: application/vnd.blackducksoftware.admin-4+json
Content-Length: 236

{
  "totalCount" : 1,
  "items" : [ {
    "name" : "name",
    "type" : "BOOLEAN",
    "supportsOptions" : false
  } ],
  "appliedFilters" : [ ],
  "_meta" : {
    "allow" : [ "GET" ],
    "href" : "https://...",
    "links" : [ ]
  }
}
```

| `items[].type`            | `String`  | True     | The enumeration value of the field data type                                         |

V4


```none
  "position" : 0,

}
```

*Table 922. Fields*

| ---------------- | --------- | -------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `active`         | `Boolean` | True     | Whether the newly created custom field will be active or not                                                                                                                        |
| `type`           | `String`  | True     | The data type of the custom field. Possible Values: [TEXT, TEXTAREA, DROPDOWN, RADIO, MULTISELECT, BOOLEAN, DATE]                                                                   |

| `initialOptions` | `Array`   | False    | A set of [custom field options](#custom-field-option-request) to be created alongside the newly created custom field. Should only be used if the custom field type supports options |
| `required`       | `Boolean` | False    | Whether the custom field is required or not. Default is false                                                                                                                       |

|  | When creating a custom field with initialOptions, each option must have a unique position and label |
| --- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |

```http
Allow: DELETE,GET,PUT
```
